title: Payroll and Compliance Manager
description:
**Company Description**
RIDEV is an electric mobility company dedicated to making sustainable transportation simple, accessible, and affordable for a wide range of users. The company provides EV rental, charging, and fleet solutions for individuals, businesses, and delivery partners, enabling an easy transition to cleaner mobility. With a strong technology-driven approach, RIDEV focuses on reliable services, smart fleet management, and a seamless user experience. By promoting eco-friendly transportation, the team is committed to reducing emissions and supporting a greener, more sustainable future for urban communities.
  
**Role Description**
The Payroll and Compliance Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Hyderabad Area. This role oversees end-to-end payroll processing for all employees, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to organizational policies and statutory requirements. The manager monitors labor laws and regulatory changes, updates payroll practices accordingly, and maintains compliance documentation and audit-ready records. Daily responsibilities include coordinating with HR and finance on employee compensation, benefits, and reimbursements, resolving payroll-related queries, and implementing controls to reduce errors and risks. The role also involves preparing regular reports, supporting internal and external audits, and contributing to process improvements and system enhancements in payroll and compliance operations.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in payroll management, including end-to-end processing, salary structure administration, and statutory deductions.
* Working knowledge of labor laws, tax regulations, social security and benefits compliance, and experience managing audits or inspections.
* Proficiency with payroll software and HRIS tools, along with advanced skills in spreadsheets and data analysis for reporting and reconciliation.
* Excellent attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion and integrity.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate across HR, finance, operations, and external vendors.
* Proven experience in a payroll or HR operations role; experience in mobility, logistics, or technology-driven companies is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, human resources, business administration, or a related field; relevant certifications in payroll or compliance are a plus.
* Ability to work on-site in the Greater Hyderabad Area and manage deadlines in a dynamic, growth-focused environment.

title: Risk Consulting - Digital Risk -Staff- Resilience - Compliance - Cyber
description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are expanding our
**Resilience, Compliance & Cyber**
team and are looking for
**Staff**
with an interest in operational resilience, technology risk, cyber risk, compliance, and governance domains. We welcome candidates with foundational knowledge and academic or practical exposure across one or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Operational Resilience and Business Continuity Management (BCM)
* Disaster Recovery (DR) and Technology Resilience
* Regulatory Compliance and Controls Assurance
* Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)
* Cyber Risk and Cyber Resilience
* Critical Business Services, Asset, and Dependency Assessments

Staff will support engagement delivery through research, testing preparations, evidence collection, documentation, analysis, and stakeholder coordination while working closely with Seniors and Managers. This role provides an excellent opportunity to build expertise in resilience, compliance, technology risk, and cyber resilience while supporting global client engagements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support operational resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, cyber resilience, and compliance assessments.
* Assist in conducting Business Impact Analyses (BIA), critical business service reviews, and dependency mapping activities.
* Support reviews of resilience and compliance programs against applicable frameworks and regulations, including ISO 22301, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, DORA, CPS 230, and NIS2.
* Participate in control testing, evidence reviews, walkthroughs, and assurance activities.
* Gather, validate, and document evidence to support assessment conclusions and client deliverables.
* Assist in the evaluation of business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, incident management, and resilience testing programs.
* Support assessments of critical processes, systems, assets, third-party providers, and operational dependencies.
* Participate in stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs.
* Identify observations, risks, and improvement opportunities under the guidance of senior team members.
* Assist in preparing reports, presentations, management summaries, and engagement documentation.
* Support project coordination activities, status tracking, and quality review procedures.
* You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
* You will anticipate and identify risks within engagement and share any issues with senior members of the team.
* In line with EY commitment to quality, you'll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Foundational understanding of Operational Resilience, Business Continuity Management (BCM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Crisis Management, and Cyber Resilience concepts.
* Basic understanding of risk management, governance, controls, and regulatory compliance principles.
* Awareness of resilience and compliance frameworks such as ISO 22301, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, DORA, CPS 230, and NIS2.
* Understanding of concepts such as Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Recovery Time Objectives (RTO), Recovery Point Objectives (RPO), critical business services, and dependency mapping.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Good documentation, communication, and report-writing skills.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work collaboratively within global and cross-functional teams.
* Interest in developing expertise across resilience, compliance, cyber risk, and technology risk domains.
* Demonstrate AI awareness and proficiency by leveraging approved AI tools to enhance productivity, improve decision-making, and drive innovation while ensuring responsible, ethical, and secure use of AI technologies.
* Champion a growth mindset toward emerging technologies by continuously building AI capabilities, identifying opportunities for AI-driven transformation, and promoting AI adoption and best practices within teams and client engagements.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Cyber Security, Risk Management, Business Continuity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Technology, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in Operational Resilience, Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Cyber Security, Technology Risk, Internal Audit, Compliance, or related disciplines.
* Understanding of risk management, cyber security, resilience, compliance, or technology governance principles through academic study, internships, certifications, projects, or professional experience.
* Exposure to control testing, audits, assessments, compliance reviews, or risk management activities is desirable but not mandatory.
* Familiarity with resilience and compliance frameworks, including ISO 22301, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), DORA, CPS 230, or NIS2, is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and willingness to learn in a consulting environment.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Exposure to Business Continuity Management (BCM), Disaster Recovery (DR), or Operational Resilience concepts through academic projects, internships, certifications, or work experience.
* Basic understanding of cyber security, technology risk, governance, or compliance processes.
* Experience supporting audits, assessments, testing activities, or control reviews.
* Exposure to critical asset assessments, dependency mapping, resilience testing, tabletop exercises, or crisis management activities.
* Proven experience in direct client facing roles, partnering with cross functional teams to deliver assessment and remediation activities.
* Familiarity with GRC, risk management, or compliance tools.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

title: Deputy Manager, Cyber Program Design and Governance- Risk and Compliance (Vendor Assessment): Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Deputy Manager, Cyber Program Design and Governance-**
**Risk and Compliance (Vendor Assessment)**
**Location:Hyderabad**
Do you have the drive to engage in cyber security risk & compliance to protect organizations from potential security exposures or threats? If your answer is yes, we have the right opportunity for you!
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
This role would be part of Cyber Security team and would actively engage in
  
  
implementing our vendor information security risk management program for achieving firm’s GRC objectives. As part of this team, you will be assisting in reviewing and assessing vendor’s information security program, processes and controls to identify weaknesses in their information system and discover potential threats to Deloitte and its assets. You would be reporting assessment results to necessary stakeholders, following up on remediation plan, ensuring timely remediation and providing appropriate recommendations to the vendor for ensuring adequate protection of Deloitte information assets. You would collaborate and coordinate with various key stakeholders, both onshore and offshore, such as vendors, internal business clients, internal teams, SMEs and Cyber Security management.
  
  

* Monitoring external policy compliance, specifically on Deloitte vendors
* Responsible for reviewing and assessing vendor security controls to protect Deloitte facilities, systems (assets and networks) and data
* Responsible for ensuring vendors working within the framework of Deloitte security policies that is being clearly laid out for them
* Maintaining regular communications with vendor risk management team on progress status
* up with vendors and business teams to ensure timely remediation of assessment findings
* Driving security awareness program across the organization and promoting cyber security firm initiatives

Educational Qualification:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business Administration or equivalent educational or professional experience and/or qualifications

title: Principal Manager, Product Management (Legal Tech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Legal team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This team delivers technology solutions that support critical firm functions and operational workflows. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will work closely with the Legal team and technology partners to assess, design, and deliver technology solutions that modernize legal operations across a broad range of functional areas, including trading agreements, investment products, intellectual property, and transactional deal support. You will also serve as a senior point of coordination for initiatives focused on legal technology transformation, evaluating build-versus-buy decisions, implementing document and knowledge management platforms, and developing AI- and metadata-enabled tools for drafting and research. Additionally, you will lead requirements gathering and prioritization across diverse stakeholder groups, define product visions and roadmaps, and identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve data integrity, and enhance operational resilience. You will balance near-term operational needs with long-term strategic and architectural objectives while building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, a related field, or an MBA, with 8+ years of product management experience, preferably within the financial services or investment management industry
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques to generate product insights, prioritize initiatives, measure outcomes, and guide product strategy
* Proven adaptability in managing changing priorities, with strong project and delivery management skills in fast-paced, dynamic environments
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams, translating nontechnical needs into clear requirements while balancing competing stakeholder priorities, building consensus, and delivering customer-focused outcomes

title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
description:
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.
  
  
Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
* Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
* Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
* Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
* Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.
  
  
Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.
  
  
**About The Team**
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.
  
  
This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience within financial services and payment institutions
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
* Master's degree or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Vice President - Corporate Secretarial
description:
**About Citco**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 80 offices worldwide. With more than $1 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.
  
  
For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com
  
  
**About The Team & Business Line**
Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.
  
  
This is an exciting new role overseeing a Corporate Secretarial function of a large and growing Private Equity, Hedge fund and Real Estate Administration business. We are looking for a dynamic and experienced leader to oversee a function across Mumbai / Hyderabad, so leadership qualities are key to doing this role well.
  
  
In addition to leading a local team, you will be working closely with teams across multiple Indian locations (Mumbai and Hyderabad) working closely with senior management in Europe. Operationally, you are skilled at leading projects, thinking through new ways of doing things, improving the business as you go. You can work with influence to ensure that the department grows in the best way possible in the interests of our clients.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Day to Day Responsibilities:**
**Management**

* Lead, coach and develop the India CoSec teams across locations, building leadership capability through delegation, knowledge transfer and succession planning.
* Drive a culture of ownership and accountability, with clear responsibility for deliverables and greater team independence.
* Lead workforce and capacity planning, including headcount, recruitment, resource allocation and onboarding to support business growth.
* Translate business, financial and client KPIs into clear team objectives, monitoring performance and driving best practices.
* Maintain high standards of service delivery, driving process efficiencies, quality improvements and opportunities for business growth.
* Provide effective oversight across locations, ensuring appropriate stakeholder coverage and acting as an escalation point where required.
* Lead the India CoSec Leadership forum, driving strategic and operational alignment, collaboration, decision-making and execution.

**Compliance / Governance**

* Implement and maintain robust processes, procedures and controls to ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements and external obligations.
* Ensure adherence to the company’s governance and control framework, including audit, risk and compliance, business continuity and applicable local regulatory requirements, while fostering a strong control environment that safeguards the firm’s assets and reputation.

**Stakeholder Work / Responsibility**

* Own end-to-end migration programs, from planning and implementation through stabilization.
* Drive Risk Event governance, ensuring timely identification, appropriate remediation and alignment with policy, Controls Office and governance requirements.
* Ensure the accuracy and integrity of management information presented to leadership.
* Strengthen the processes for chargeability of time for the clients, KPI governance and reporting frameworks to drive consistent and accurate reporting across migrated and direct clients.
* Standardize processes across direct client portfolios to enable a scalable and consistent operating model.
* Translate global CoSec priorities into actionable plans, with clear ownership, effective execution and measurable outcomes.
* Lead cross-jurisdictional outsourcing governance, maintaining effective oversight of reporting, controls and deliverables.
* Drive continuous improvement and scalability across the function to support evolving business requirements.
* Lead CoSec transformation and automation initiatives, including solution implementation, stakeholder alignment, testing and adoption.
* Drive service quality and operational excellence by identifying process and quality gaps, addressing root causes and embedding sustainable controls to reduce recurring issues.

**Profile**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Company Secretarial qualification and/or Law degree preferred; other relevant professional qualifications will also be considered.
* 18+ years of corporate experience, including at least 10 years in senior managerial roles, with demonstrated experience leading large teams within an international organization.
* Strong experience operating in an international environment, with project management capability and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.
* Sound understanding of Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Real Assets Funds and SPV structures, including relevant reporting and European statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Proven ability to lead, develop and motivate teams, while fostering a positive, collaborative and sustainable working environment.
* Demonstrated experience in developing, implementing and optimizing Company Secretarial processes, particularly within Private Equity, Real Assets and SPV administration.
* Fluent in English, with advanced Microsoft Office skills and a strong interest in transformation, automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

title: US Immigration Executive
description:

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced
**US Immigration Executive**
with 3-5 years to manage end-to-end employment-based immigration processes for our organization. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience handling various work visa categories, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Requests for Evidence (RFEs), Labor Condition Applications (LCAs), prevailing wage requirements, occupation code classifications, and complete immigration documentation. This role requires strong organizational skills, a thorough understanding of U.S. immigration regulations, and the ability to coordinate effectively with attorneys, employees, HR, recruiters, and government agencies.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete lifecycle of employment-based immigration cases from initiation through approval.
* Coordinate and process work visa petitions, including H-1B, H-1B Transfers, H-1B Amendments, H-1B Extensions, and other employment-based visa categories.

* Coordinate with immigration attorneys on case preparation, filing strategies, and legal documentation.
* Manage and respond to Requests for Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and audit requests by gathering supporting documentation and preparing response packages.
* Maintain accurate immigration records, employee files, case trackers, and compliance documentation.
* Ensure adherence to USCIS, Department of Labor (DOL), and Department of State immigration regulations and filing deadlines.
* Track case progress and provide regular status updates to employees, hiring managers, HR, and leadership.
* Review immigration documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance before submission.
* Support employees throughout the immigration process by answering questions and providing timely guidance.
* Assist with public access file (PAF) preparation and maintenance for H-1B compliance.
* Monitor changes in U.S. immigration laws, policies, and procedures and recommend process improvements.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of experience managing employment-based U.S. immigration cases.
* Strong understanding of USCIS, Department of Labor (DOL), and employment-based immigration regulations.
* Experience handling PERM Labor Certification, I-140 petitions, and employment-based visa processing.
* Hands-on experience drafting LCAs and working with Prevailing Wage Determinations and wage levels.
* Knowledge of SOC occupation codes and job classification requirements.
* Experience preparing documentation for RFEs, audits, and other immigration-related requests.
* Familiarity with immigration case management systems and document management tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with immigration attorneys or corporate immigration teams.
* Experience with immigration compliance reporting and internal audits.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing strict deadlines.
* Familiarity with E-Verify, I-9 compliance, and employment eligibility verification processes.

Key Skills

* Employment-Based Immigration
* H-1B Visa Processing
* PERM Labor Certification
* I-140 Petitions
* Labor Condition Applications (LCA)
* Prevailing Wage Determinations (PWD)
* Wage Level Analysis
* SOC Occupation Codes
* USCIS Compliance
* Department of Labor (DOL) Regulations
* RFE & NOID Response Management
* Immigration Documentation
* Case Management
* Process Improvement
* Time Management
* Communication & Documentation

title: FAAS - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Manager – Control & Compliance**
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support. We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS, having expertise across the FAAS solutions and specifically for engagements related to Process and Control, Process compliance and reviews, SOX and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Enterprise Risk Management & Payment application.
  
  
FAAS is a dynamic group of people focused on helping our clients solving tomorrow’s problems today through integrated solution service offerings in the area of risk, such as internal control assessment, risk management and financial controls. Risk continues to move up the agenda and our team work with many of today's front-running companies. Our clients want integrated, strategic, tech-enabled, end-to-end solutions and we deliver tailored risk offerings putting client value and relationships at the core of what we do. You can expect to work with senior client personnel and drive high quality work products.
  
  
Our Risk team consists of talented colleagues who invite you to bring your natural curiosity and innovative thoughts to work each day. Working within our team, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We offer excellent career development, diverse opportunities and fantastic work life balance including hybrid working. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated manager to join our dynamic Control & Compliance team. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise in risk management, internal control assessment and implementation of internal control framework. In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**

* You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.
* Technology and innovation: Proficient in leveraging technology such as data analytics, automation, and AI in project delivery. Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and core business systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficient across the Microsoft Office suite (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel and Word). Ability to develop dashboards across key data visualization tools and produce visual reports to track key risks and control metrics, noted as desirable but not essential.
* Professional attributes: Self-stater with a proactive mindset, natural curiosity and commitment to delivering excellence for our clients. Ability to work in areas of uncertainty and navigate ambiguous situations, adaptable and inclusive, with strong self-awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams. Up to date with industry trends, emerging risks, and the UK regulatory landscape. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Other desirable skills and experience: Professional experience, skills and knowledge in the following areas is desirable but not essential; finance transformation, controls automation, programme assurance, IT control including analysing core systems (e.g., SAP and Oracle) to identify control weaknesses

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Significant managerial and professional experience in risk, process and controls services in a consulting, industry or public sector setting.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US), ACCA (UK) or MBA with 5-10 years of experience with a large global corporate Process, Risk and Control and/or similar experience
* Experience on the following Process and Control / SOX areas:

+ Governance, controls and regulation
+ Governance, Risk & Compliance
+ Process and Control
+ Process reviews
+ Standard Operating Procedures
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Revenue Assurance
+ SOX
+ Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
+ Design and Implementation testing
+ Process walkthroughs and testing effectiveness of controls

* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Strong sales, presentation and client management skills
* Strong training and mentoring skills
* Ability to manage a team and to establish credibility as a trusted advisor with clients
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex information in a concise and clear manner
* Strong executive presence and ability to interface with all levels of management (EY and clients)
* Strong project management and organizational experience
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**What we look for:**

* We are interested to hear from entrepreneurial people who feed on the energy of a thriving global team. We seek a high level of drive, commitment to achieving solutions, and ability to work under pressure. We need people worthy of trust, who demonstrate enthusiasm, passion to grow fast and are highly motivated to support this purpose.
* We invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. If you want to know more about our people and our culture, search #EyCulture on LinkedIn.

**What we offer:**
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
  
  
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next, including having the opportunity to gain an EY Tech MBA which is an accredited MBA program offered to all EY professionals globally
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Cyber - Digital Trust & Online Protection - Product Compliance - L45
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Data Protection - Product Compliance - Senior Consultant**
Deloitte's Regulatory, Risk & Forensic practice helps clients turn evolving regulatory and risk requirements into practical action. Our Product Compliance practice supports technology, media, and telecommunications organizations in embedding compliance across the product lifecycle, from strategy and design through launch, monitoring, and incident response, including for artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled and agentic products. Join a team that combines data, AI, emerging technology, and industry insight to help clients navigate complexity and create value.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Security Engineer III on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Support product compliance program design and transformation, including operating models, product lifecycle processes, governance, compliance-by-design, automation, testing, and issue remediation.
* Translate regulatory developments affecting software, digital platforms, and AI-enabled products into product requirements, risk taxonomies, control architectures, and policies.
* Assess product processes, data flows, and controls, including identity, access, data use, and third-party dependencies, to support risk assessments and compliance-by-design practices.
* Execute control testing, launch-readiness reviews, red-teaming, release regression testing, key risk and control indicator monitoring, incident exercises, and evidence management for requests for information (RFIs) and audits.
* Support AI and agentic product compliance, data, identity, and access governance, age assurance, youth-by-design, and third-party risk; manage workstreams and contribute to client deliverables, proposals, and thought leadership.

**The team**
Deloitte's Data and Digital Trust practice helps clients use data responsibly while safeguarding privacy, security, and digital trust. We advise, implement, and operate solutions across privacy governance and compliance, data protection and compliance, digital trust and online protection, risk and controls enablement, and technology implementation. Our teams help organizations respond to changing regulations, consumer expectations, and technology developments while advancing sustainable digital transformation.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Law, Business Management, or Public Policy
* 4+ years of experience in technology, media, and telecommunications or consulting in product compliance program design, product risk assessments, compliance-by-design, trust and safety, regulatory implementation, product compliance testing and validation, compliance automation, regulatory readiness, or data analysis.
* Experience supporting client engagements or project workstreams in a consulting, advisory, or professional services environment.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with product regulations and frameworks, including the Digital Markets Act, Digital Services Act, Cyber Resilience Act, European Union Data Act, European Union Artificial Intelligence Act, United Kingdom Online Safety Act, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), age-appropriate design and youth online safety laws, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework, or International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission (ISO/IEC) 42001.

* Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) and compliance automation tools, including ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Archer, or policy-as-code integrations in continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.
* Experience supporting product compliance, trust and safety, or regulatory risk functions in a technology, media, and telecommunications company or other regulated industry, including risk assessments, reporting, controls, testing, or data analytics.
* Experience with artificial intelligence (AI) governance, age assurance and youth safety, or product data, identity, and access governance for digital products.
* Experience partnering with product, engineering, legal, and policy teams to embed compliance requirements in product design, user stories, and release processes; supporting proposal development, client presentations, or business development activities; or holding a Master of Business Administration, Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager, Certified Information Privacy Professional, AI Governance Professional, Certified Information Systems Auditor, Project Management Professional, or Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control designation.

title: Senior Compliance & Security Specialist
description:
About Us
  
At PeopleLC, we are the architects behind the teams building the future at our Client partners. We design, deploy, and manage the highly sophisticated screening, assessment ecosystem, and career management that evaluates every single engineer, professionals, and leaders applying to work at the Client place. We don't just look for professionals; we use advanced behavioral, technical, and psychological data models to identify the exact quadrant of engineering and workforce excellence required for our Client's success. PeopleLC is a premier career management, HMTR, AI resources, and workforce solutions firm. We act as the strategic architecture partner for high-innovation companies
  
  
Description
  
Our Client is building the future of work, innovating on our customers ’behalf across industries including healthcare, financial services, transportation and supply chain, and retail. We are crafting a unique workplace culture that combines data-driven rigor, relentless customer obsession, and high ownership with innovation and employee-centric creativity. We work hard, iterate fast, and care deeply about building a supportive, elite team.
  
  
Description
  
Our Client is looking for a Compliance / Security Analyst to help build and run the security and compliance program that our customers depend on. They serve healthcare, financial services, transportation, and retail organizations, and their trust in our platform rests on the strength of our controls.
  
We are in the middle of our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 journeys and growing quickly after a recent merger. You will own day-to-day control operations, drive audit readiness, answer customer security reviews, and help mature our security posture as we scale. This is a high- ownership role with direct visibility to executive leadership.
  
  
Key Job Responsibilities
  
Operate and continuously monitor controls for SOC 2 (Type 1 and Type 2) and ISO 27001, including evidence
  
collection, control testing, and remediation tracking.
  
Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies, coordinating requests and timelines across teams.
  
Maintain the information security management system (ISMS): policies, procedures, risk register, Statement of
  
Applicability, and internal audit schedule.
  
Own and improve our GRC tooling and automate evidence collection wherever possible.
  
Complete customer security questionnaires, due diligence requests, and contract security requirements, including HIPAA and financial services expectations.
  
Run third-party and vendor risk assessments and track vendor compliance.
  
Lead periodic access reviews, security awareness training, and policy attestation campaigns.
  
Support vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident response, including tracking findings through to closure.
  
Help integrate acquired teams and systems into our control environment.
  
  
Note on your contact details and requirement
  
PeopleLC reserve the right to share your contact details and profile with third parties for job matching, business requirements, and marketing or sales initiatives.
  
  
A day in work
  
Your day could begin by checking the GRC dashboard for failing controls and pinging
  
owners to fix a missed access review. Mid-morning you meet the ISO 27001 auditor to walk through a corrective action. In the afternoon you complete a security questionnaire for a healthcare prospect, then work with engineering to automate evidence for a change-management control so it never has to be collected by hand again.
  
  
Basic Qualifications
  
Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  
3+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC, IT audit, or information security. Hands-on experience supporting SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 audits from readiness through report.
  
Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and common security controls such as IAM,
  
logging, encryption, and change management.
  
Strong written communication and the ability to manage many requests across teams with attention to detail.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, or CompTIA Security+.
  
Experience with HIPAA, HITRUST, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, or SOX ITGCs.
  
Experience with GRC platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe.
  
Familiarity with SIEM, EDR, and vulnerability scanning tools.
  
Scripting skills (Python or PowerShell) to automate evidence and reporting.
  
Experience in a high-growth startup or a post-merger integration.
  
Our Client is an equal opportunity employer. They value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disabilities.

title: Senior Consultant - Digital Validation & IT Compliance
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About the Tech@Lilly Organization:**
Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using cutting edge technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Tech@Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of the enterprise.
  
  
**About The Business Function**
The Tech@Lilly Digital Office (DO) and Global Services (GS) team leads digitalization across organizations spanning the enterprise with Finance, Legal, Ethics & Compliance, Corporate Affairs and Human Resources as well delivers best-in-class ERP Solutions.   This team leverages technology and analytics to enable transformations across the enterprise.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Consultant - Validation**
As a Senior Consultant - Validation, you will be responsible for driving Computer System Validation (CSV)/Computer Software Assurance (CSA) activities, ensuring compliance, quality, and efficiency across Lilly computer systems following Lilly standards and processes.
  
  
You also will be responsible to drive innovation by leveraging AI, digital tools, and automation to simplify and automate CSV processes.
  
  
**About The Team**
Validation - Center of Excellence (CoE) is a specialized team that provides CSV services across all Tech@Lilly business functions. We adopt a modern, enterprise-wide approach that emphasizes automation and simplification, ensuring validation activities are consistent, effective, and aligned with industry best practices and regulations.
  
  
The DO/GS organization is actively looking for a motivated candidate. In this role, you will be responsible for driving IT quality & compliance, and assurance across Lilly’s mission-critical systems spanning across various business functions.
  
  
Do you have a passion for shaping the future of validation by embracing modern approaches like use of AI and Automation in validation? If so, please apply.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Innovation & Automation:**

* Drive innovation in validation by exploring and leveraging AI, digital tools, and automation technologies to streamline validation documentation, authoring, and review processes.
* Identify opportunities to simplify CSV/CSA activities through adoption of risk-based approaches, automation frameworks, and smart documentation solutions, reducing effort while maintaining compliance.
* Continuously evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., AI-assisted authoring, digital validation platforms) and recommend practical use cases for efficiency and quality improvement.
* Identify and drive continuous improvement, automation, and simplification opportunities in validation processes using digital tools or AI-enabled solutions.

**Project Validation**

* Lead and coordinate IT system validation by managing the computer system lifecycle from validation/test planning to reporting and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, Lilly processes and validation standards.
* Responsible for applying appropriate right sizing method/approach and determining the nature and content of deliverables in scope.
* Oversee AI/auto generated validation documents by reviewing and updating contents to ensure accuracy, compliance, and alignment with Lilly’s quality management system.
* Review all the project validation deliverables authored by the project team (developer, SME etc.).
* Escalate and communicate operational issues, critical compliance findings and risks to the Information System Quality (ISQ) organization and other key stakeholders of the system.
* Educate project team members on Lilly IT processes and methodologies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate compliance risks, while providing guidance and training on best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Advise project team on implementation of compliance and security control requirements at the appropriate stages of system development.
* Contribute to internal and external audits, assessments or inspections.

**Change Management**

* Ensures IT system change requests (CR) are executed in compliance with Local/global change control procedures.
* Review CRs and ensure the accuracy and completeness of all change requests.
* Review the impacted validation deliverables.

**Access Roster, Privacy And Periodic Review**

* Facilitate and support the system custodian/owner and area management to execute access roster and periodic review followed by respective Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) closure.

**How You Will Succeed:**

* Achieving measurable improvements in validation efficiency (e.g., reduced cycle time, higher CSA adoption, increased compliance).
* Contributing to continuous improvement for documentation and validation processes for functional areas.
* Promoting simplification and harmonization across systems and geographies.
* Mentoring and coaching junior validation staff, foster a quality culture across teams.
* Driving CSA adoption to simplify and modernize CSV, focusing on risk-based assurance rather than excessive documentation.

**What You Should Bring**

* In-depth knowledge of regulations, guidelines, and industry standards related to CSV, data integrity, and computerized systems like GxP, GAMP 5, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, 21 CFR 210, 21 CFR 211, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA++ Principles, etc.
* Experience in leading CSV activities across the full system lifecycle (implementation, upgrades, retirement).
* Expertise in documents creation which includes, but not limited to validation plan, System Configuration, System Overview, Security Plan and validation report, etc.
* Hands-on expertise in preparing, reviewing, and approving validation deliverables.
* Strong knowledge of IT system operational compliance processes, including Periodic Reviews and Access Roster Reviews.
* Proven ability to apply risk-based validation approaches in alignment with CSA principles to balance compliance with efficiency.
* Hands-on experience with commonly used industry tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Veeva).

**Basic Qualifications And Experience Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field,
* Overall 8-10+ years of experience in CSV in pharmaceuticals or life sciences industry.
* Must have extensive knowledge of GxP, regulatory requirements, and IT system validation processes.
* Demonstrated expertise in leading compliance initiatives and fostering cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong experience in regulatory compliance, validation processes, risk assessment, IT systems change management, stakeholder collaboration, continuous improvement, project management, and analytical problem-solving.
* Ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical team members.

**Additional Skills/Preferences**

* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, problem solving, and investigative skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Knowledge of Agile principles and frameworks (e.g., Scrum, SAFe), including related tools (such as Jira).
* Demonstrated leadership skills and effectiveness in the areas of influence, team leadership, articulating and taking a position, negotiation, and conflict resolution.

**Additional Information**
Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team will support continuous operations across two shifts and therefore, this role will require non-standard work hours, and some work on weekends and holidays.  Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non-standard hours where applicable.

Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

In addition to being a major independent power producer in India, ReNew is evolving to become an end-to-end decarbonization partner providing solutions in a just and inclusive manner in the areas of clean energy, green hydrogen, value-added energy offerings through digitalisation, storage, and carbon markets that increasingly are integral to addressing climate change. With a total capacity of more than 13.4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew’s solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1.9 % of India’s power capacity. Consequently, this has helped to avoid 0.5% of India’s total carbon emissions and 1.1% India’s total power sector emissions. In the over 10 years of its operation, ReNew has generated almost 1.3 lakh jobs, directly and indirectly. ReNew has achieved market leadership in the Indian renewable energy industry against the backdrop of the Government of India’s policies to promote growth of this sector. ReNew’s current group of stockholders contains several marquee investors including CPP Investments, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Goldman Sachs, GEF SACEF and JERA. Its mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India’s growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner. ReNew stands committed to providing clean, safe, affordable, and sustainable energy for all and has been at the forefront of leading climate action in India.

title: Business Execution Consultant
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Business Execution Consultant.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Participate in a variety of assigned and ongoing business operations to ensure success in meeting business goals and objectives
* Identify opportunities for process improvement by conducting root cause testing of all compliance and business metrics
* Determine areas of strength or Business Execution opportunity within defined scope of work
* Review and research strategies and action plans to establish effective processes while meeting performance metrics and policy expectations
* Utilize independent judgment to guide moderate risk deliverables
* Present recommendations to develop, implement, and monitor strategic approaches, effectiveness of support function, and business performance improvement opportunities for managing risks of the business
* Exercise independent judgment and provide guidance in diverse support functions and operations for a single business group within a line of business
* Collaborate and consult with leaders and executive management
* Provide work direction to less experienced Strategy and Execution staff

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Possess strong knowledge of banking products and services across key lines of business, including Consumer Lending, Commercial Banking, Wealth & Investment Banking, Trade Finance, and Capital Markets.
* Manage third-party due diligence activities across the relationship lifecycle, including planning and intake, onboarding, risk assessment, contracting, ongoing monitoring, change events, renewal, and termination.

**Job Expectations**

* Assess and document the business rationale for engaging a third party, including the nature, scope, criticality, data access, technology dependency, regulatory considerations, and inherent risks associated with the proposed service.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of third-party risk management principles to identify, assess, document, escalate, and support the mitigation of risks related to cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, operational resilience, business continuity, regulatory compliance, financial viability, subcontractor use, concentration, and reputational exposure.
* Evaluate different service types, delivery models, engagement structures, and third-party dependencies to determine applicable due diligence requirements, risk domains, control expectations, and level of ongoing oversight.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather complete and accurate information regarding the service, data flows, system access, locations, subcontractors, critical processes, and intended use of the third party.
* Review submitted documentation and stakeholder responses for completeness, consistency, and accuracy; identify information gaps; obtain clarifications; and ensure due diligence records are maintained in the designated system with a clear audit trail.
* Coordinate with Lines of Business, Risk Partners, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Information Security, Sourcing, and other subject matter experts to resolve questions, address control gaps, and support timely completion of risk evaluations.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for new and existing third-party relationships by interpreting policy requirements, identifying material risks, advising stakeholders on required actions, and supporting risk-based decisions.
* Translate complex risk, policy, and control requirements into clear, practical, and actionable guidance for business stakeholders, enabling them to understand their responsibilities and meet established requirements.
* Exercise independent judgment and effective challenge when business responses, proposed controls, risk acceptance decisions, or supporting evidence do not adequately address identified exposure or policy expectations.
* Provide timely interim updates, escalation communications, final assessment outcomes, and recommended next steps to relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency regarding open issues, dependencies, and potential delays.
* Monitor remediation plans, control gaps, exceptions, and outstanding actions through closure; escalate overdue or material items in accordance with governance and risk-management requirements.
* Identify areas of operational strength and opportunities to improve business execution, workflow discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, cycle time, control effectiveness, and adherence to service-level expectations.
* Research, develop, and recommend process improvements, action plans, standard procedures, controls, reporting mechanisms, and strategic approaches that improve the effectiveness and scalability of the third-party risk management program.
* Track performance against established metrics and policy requirements, analyze trends and recurring issues, and present clear recommendations to management for strengthening risk governance and business performance.
* Maintain current knowledge of enterprise third-party risk management policies, standards, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry practices, and apply that knowledge consistently across assigned engagements.
* Assess third-party technology, cloud, software-as-a-service, and artificial intelligence use cases in coordination with relevant specialists, considering factors such as data handling, access controls, model governance, human oversight, transparency, resilience, subcontractor dependencies, and compliance with technology and vendor-management requirements.
* Support an accountable, collaborative, and risk-aware culture by managing multiple priorities, meeting committed timelines, maintaining high-quality documentation, and communicating professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

**Posting End Date**
3 Nov 2026
  
  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

**We Value Equal Opportunity**
Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
  
  
Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

* Act as key participant in large scale planning, gathering data to support resolution of issues in areas in and out of responsibility

* Work closely with stakeholders across the US, EMEA, and India

You will help define the right models, tools and mechanisms necessary to address business opportunities, drive automation, improve controllership and earn trust across the tax organization. Amazon has a culture of being builders and you will get to use the latest technology and internal Amazon tools to help scale big and fast.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated great attention to detail, a proven track record of building and improving complex financial models, effective written and verbal communication skills and a strong desire to continuously learn and invent. You must be a fast learner who can quickly understand Amazon's data structure. You need to be analytical in decision-making with ability to drive issues to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Perform hands-on data delivery, detailed data research and analysis of large-scale, complex financial data sets; investigate, troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data
* Collaborate with customer teams to identify opportunities for improving efficiency and controllership in current processes to eliminate manual efforts within the US Federal Tax Return and worldwide tax provision
* Drive process improvements and coordinate with the Tax Technology team to facilitate streamlining and automation
* Develop tax models for various tax calculations and review tools through the creation of end-to-end scalable processes by leveraging technology.
* Preparation and review of tax adjustments, audit-ready workpapers and federal tax returns for US reporting
* Stay up-to-date on tax law and organizational impact of those changes

**About The Team**
The Federal Reporting and Compliance team manages Amazon's worldwide taxable income calculations and federal tax obligations. We own the full lifecycle of federal tax provision and compliance, including worldwide taxable income calculations for quarterly closes, forecasts, and annual returns. While collaborating with specialist teams on areas like stock compensation, R&D credits, and TCJA provisions, we drive technological innovation and process improvements to enhance efficiency and controllership in our deliverables. Our work directly impacts Amazon's global tax provision and US federal income tax reporting.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business or related field
* 2+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
* Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
* Experience with Corptax tax return and provision preparation or equivalent software
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CPA
* Passion for process, data and efficiencies
* Positive mindset, strong professionalism, sound judgment and an insatiable intellectual curiosity

description:

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. **Role Overview**
The Facilities & Compliance Manager is responsible for overseeing workplace operations, infrastructure management, travel administration, and regulatory compliance for the organization’s office facilities. This role leads the corporate services function, manages vendor relationships, oversees travel and expense processes, and ensures operational readiness to support business growth. * Supervise and mentor facilities administrators and corporate services staff.

* Facilities management and workplace operations
* Regulatory compliance and safety management
