title: Compliance Monitoring & Testing L4
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
Since 2011, we have been fully devoted to our Mission: Money without borders. Instant, convenient, and eventually free. Over 16 million people and businesses use Wise, which processes over £9 billion in cross-border transactions every month, saving customers over £1.5 billion a year. We serve a wide range of customers from personal users, freelancers, small businesses and increasingly even to large enterprises and banks. Wise also offers over 50 currencies for customers to hold and convert money in.
  
  
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
As a member of the Compliance Monitoring and Testing team, you will support the execution of our Compliance monitoring and testing programme across Markets.
  
  
You will work closely with Compliance Officers, Product, Operations and other teams to understand how Wise's Financial Crime and regulatory compliance controls operate, assess whether they are working as intended, identify areas for improvement and support the delivery of clear, evidence-based monitoring and testing outcomes.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to deepen their Compliance expertise while developing practical experience in compliance monitoring, controls testing, data analysis and risk assessment within a fast-growing global fintech organisation.
  
  
Building trust
  
  

* Support and perform processes and controls testing, including gathering evidence, completing testing procedures, documenting results and identifying potential control gaps.
* Document testing performed, evidence reviewed, conclusions reached and any identified issues & communicate potential gaps, risks and observations to senior members of the Monitoring and Testing team and other stakeholders.
* Validate the effectiveness of regulatory controls to build a trusted relationship with key stakeholders.

Strengthening the regulatory compliance framework
  
  

* Execute assigned Compliance monitoring and testing activities across markets in line with agreed plans and methodologies.
* Proactively monitor compliance health in the markets using data and visualisation tools.
* Support the development of compliance compliance indicators and contribute to the monitoring of compliance health.

**This Role Will Give You The Opportunity To**

* Develop an in-depth knowledge of Wise’s business and get to know teams across Wise as you work with them to understand the product and regulatory framework.
* Champion compliance through monitoring and testing by designing and executing a monitoring and testing plan for the region, sharing findings with your tribe and work together to strengthen our compliance program.

Your work will help ensure our compliance controls remain robust, scalable, and aligned with both global and local regulatory requirements. By collaborating with cross-functional teams and regional stakeholders, you will play an integral part in protecting Wise’s customers, reputation, and business operations.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience: You have 2 to 5 years of experience in a compliance or internal/ external audit role.
* Knowledge: You have a good foundational understanding of Financial Crime or regulatory compliance risks and controls. You understand the principles of risks, controls and assurance and have experience reviewing processes, analysing evidence or testing whether controls are operating effectively, particularly in relation to EU / UK/ US rules and/or global compliance requirements.
* Technical skills: You have an understanding of compliance risks and controls and are able to formulate risk based compliance monitoring and testing programs across different markets. Ideally, you have the ability to identify and analyse emerging compliance risks relevant to Wise.
* Project management and communication: You have the ability to write and communicate clearly about our products, processes and controls as well as how they can be improved. You’re able to analyse different viewpoints across stakeholders and tailor your communication to get the message across
* Innovation: You have a passion for compliance operational efficiency and are able to work along with our analysts and engineers to develop a data driven approach to compliance monitoring and testing. Having some experience using analytical tools (ie. SQL, Python) is an advantage.
* Autonomous: You’re a proactive problem solver and able to work independently to contribute to the team’s overall objectives. You’re adaptable to evolving priorities and have a strong ability to project manage such changes effectively.

Additional Information
  
  
**Why Join Wise**

* Make an Impact: Directly influence Wise’s compliance strategy, protecting our customers globally and shaping the evolution of our compliance framework.
* Career Growth: Immerse yourself in a fast-paced environment with opportunities to learn, develop, and grow alongside some of the brightest in the industry.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a diverse team that thrives on innovation, passionate about driving lasting change in international finance.
* Great Perks: From stock options to private medical insurance, and from flexible working to generous parental leave, we’ve got you covered.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Senior Cloud Security and compliance Engineer
description:
**What Ibexlabs Does**

Ibexlabs is one of the leading software development and service companies. We build cloud native B2B SaaS software helping customers in their cloud transformation journey. We are rapidly growing and looking to hire smart people who can continue fueling our growth and be part of our success journey.

**Position Details**

**Job Purpose**

We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer (with 5 years of experience in a public cloud environment), who is passionate about security design, architecture and implementation and learning new technologies and growing her/himself in his/her career.

As a Security Engineer, you will help guide our customers with the assessment through AWS Well Architected Framework of their public cloud infra with remediation and recommendation. You will also help our customers to make them SOC2 (Service Organisation Control) certified including policies/procedures creation and guiding and mentoring the rest of the team members.

**Responsibilities and Requirements**

* Manage and maintain compliance programs across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, Cyber Essentials and related regulatory standards using compliance automation platforms including Drata and Sprinto.
* Coordinate end-to-end audit activities, including evidence collection, auditor coordination, remediation tracking, and compliance readiness management.
* Conduct enterprise risk assessments, vendor security assessments (VASQ), and vulnerability management activities to identify and mitigate security and compliance risks.
* Administer and monitor security tools such as JumpCloud and Trend Micro, including access management, endpoint security monitoring, and incident response support.
* Perform vulnerability assessments and remediation tracking using tools such as AWS Inspector, Nmap, Detectify, and ZAP OWASP.
* Coordinate penetration testing engagements, track remediation activities, and support security improvement initiatives across customer and internal environments.
* Develop, review, and maintain security policies, procedures, runbooks, and compliance documentation aligned with industry standards and organizational requirements.
* Execute periodic security awareness training, phishing simulation campaigns, incident response exercises, and business continuity/disaster recovery testing.
* Conduct periodic administrative access reviews, log monitoring, and security control validations to ensure compliance with internal security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, auditors, vendors, and stakeholders to support security operations, compliance initiatives, and continuous improvement activities.

While we obsess over customers, we specialize in obsessing over bad actors to identify their friction points and multiply them exponentially in ways that don’t impact good sellers. • Maintain meticulously structured document repository systems, tracking key transactional deadlines, closing schedules, and legal conditions.

• High Precision: Exceptional attention to detail in drafting legal instruments, catching minor title discrepancies, and managing strict time deadlines.

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because Good Health Can’t Wait.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Compliance Manager for our Global Generics - India Sub-continent business. You will be involved in the creation, implementation, monitoring and effective compliance by the business stakeholders to key compliance polices as applicable to the marketing, promotional, sales and other commercial activities in GG India BU. This position will work closely with other compliance team members and support initiatives from various subject matter experts and stakeholders in the legal, finance departments.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

• You will be responsible for advising business stakeholders on carrying out business activities as per Dr Reddy's policies and the GG India SOPs and supporting other functions like Finance, HR etc in the same.

• You will be responsible for reviewing and approving marketing plans, HCP engagements and other material submitted to the compliance team's pre-clearance through m-Hub/LMRC and our ARF systems.

• You will be responsible for conducting in-depth root cause analysis, identification of processes and controls which are working and not working and suggesting corrective and preventive actions. You will also work alongside the Ombuds team in implementing their CAPAs and in upgrading processes and systems to prevent repetition of like issues in future

• You will be responsible for participating in the training, communication, and sensitization of the aspects of Code of Business Conduct and Ethics (COBE), GGI Marketing Code and other key compliance policies.

• You will be responsible for implementation of UCPMP/similar guidelines in the day-to-day conduct of business and preparing and presenting of key findings for senior management

**Qualifications**

Educational qualification: Lawyer or chartered accountant

Minimum work experience: 9-12 years in a compliance-related role, with a focus on policy writing, compliance advisory and CAPA management in pharmaceutical organisation.

**Additional Information**

**Technical Skills**

• Demonstrated understanding of the general pharmaceutical business, showcasing knowledge of industry dynamics, trends, and challenges.

• Strong proficiency in drafting policies & SOPs.

• Extensive experience in monitoring and in scrutiny of documents and records

• In-depth knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Demonstrated expertise in compliance management and advising on pharma marketing and UCPMP.

• Proven track record in corporate compliance and implementing effective compliance programs.

**Behavioural skills**

• Strong written and oral communication abilities, facilitating effective expression of ideas.

• Demonstrates analytical thinking, enabling effective problem-solving and decision-making.

• Ability to multitask and manage a variety of business requirements simultaneously.

• Approaches tasks with a positive "can-do" attitude, demonstrating optimism and a solution-oriented mind set.

• Effective people management skills with colleagues and clients, fostering positive relationships.

• Competence in operating effectively within a diverse and complex matrix organization.

title: Vendor Relationship Manager III
description:
**Role Overview**
The VMO Analyst (Level III - Subject Matter Expert) serves as the primary strategic and governance coordination point for the global vendor, software contract, and hardware supply chain ecosystems.
  
  
Positioned above tactical queue operations, this role oversees contract metadata accuracy, high-value spend compliance, external workforce governance, and vendor performance audits. The Level III Analyst acts as the ultimate escalation point for transaction anomalies, coordinates critical M&A integration tracks, and anchors the Semi-Annual Supplier Business Review (SBR) cycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Supplier Governance & Performance Management (SBR):
* Project manage the end-to-end Semi-Annual Supplier Business Review cycle for major global original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and value-added resellers (VARs). Design and collect performance feedback surveys, conduct live stakeholder polling to eliminate bias, and compile unified supplier performance scorecards. Formally record action items and due dates during reviews and track post-SBR deliverables.
* Contract Lifecycle & Financial Compliance:
* Manage high-value contract records and track critical compliance milestones—including contract executions, renewals, true-ups, and expirations—within the enterprise Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) database. Enforce strict financial governance, ensuring no deal over $2M USD proceeds to contract signature without an approved spend authority approval artifact verified and uploaded. Audit complex prepaid software and hardware contracts to verify amortization schedules and ensure general ledger (GL) accuracy.
* M&A Contract & License Integration:
* Standardize, triage, and map software and hardware portfolios acquired during Mergers & Acquisitions using specialized trackers. Maintain the master integration register and run validation audits to isolate and filter out out-of-scope third-party embedded technology. Coordinate pre-close and post-close software deprovisioning, verifying Personally Identifiable Information (PII) constraints and securing formal Data Deletion Notices.
* External Workforce Policy Governance:
* Serve as the final compliance gatekeeper for contingent workforce onboarding and extension requests. Audit request submissions daily to verify manager hierarchies, confirm budget approvals, and enforce strict country-specific Length of Service and tenure policies before authorizing engagements.
* External Workforce Policy Governance:
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex purchase order pricing or quantity disputes raised by suppliers. Isolate commercial discussions by managing secure child ticketing workflows to shield internal strategy discussions from external vendors. Troubleshoot back-end system errors (such as missing supplier-item mappings or catalog blocks) to push correct records live in the procurement database.

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS
  
  
Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured by location per service line.
  
  

* Contract Compliance: ensure 100% of reviewed supplier and software contracts comply with the client's agreed criteria (tracked as a KPI).
* Renewal Timeliness: complete contract renewals and milestone registrations ahead of expiry for ≥98% of in-scope agreements, with zero unintended lapses or auto-renewals.
* Repository Accuracy: maintain ≥99% accuracy across contract records, key dates and obligation metadata.
* Ticket Quality: ensure ≥95–97% of completed requests pass quality-assurance checks, with complete and accurate documentation, correct categorization, and full adherence to the approved SOP for the request type.
* SLA Response by Ticket Priority: Acknowledge and assign incoming VMO escalations within standard windows: 1 hour for high-priority issues, 3 hours for normal requests, and 6 hours for standard tickets.
* Workforce Audit SLA: Validate and process standard external worker and extension compliance reviews within 3 business days.
* Contract & Catalog Accuracy: Maintain a strict 100% compliance rate on all reviewed contracts and ensure 99% or higher data accuracy across storefront catalog and purchase information record updates.
* Queue Discipline: Perform detailed follow-up actions and update statuses on all open or pending VMO, contract, and escalation cases every 3 days to prevent backlog build-up.
* Workforce Audit SLA: validate and process standard temporary worker and extension compliance reviews within 3 business days.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS
  
  

* Contract Repositories: Enterprise Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) databases and supplier-contract tracking systems.
* ERP & Procurement Systems: SAP ERP (specifically Materials Management, Finance/Accounts Payable, and Procure-to-Pay modules) and enterprise guided buying networks.
* Workforce Management Platforms: Specialized vendor management applications (such as SAP Fieldglass) and organization directories.
* Ticketing & Collaboration Tools: Advanced enterprise ITSM platforms, collaborative spreadsheet logs, and secure project communication channels.

**Required Skills & Experience**
Mandatory
  
  

* 5 to 8 years of professional experience in supplier relationship management, corporate contract lifecycle administration, procurement, or external workforce compliance.
* Expert-level understanding of global import/export regulations, Incoterms, trade classifications, and corporate capitalization thresholds.
* Hands-on expertise executing transactions, managing Purchase Information Records, and maintaining catalog master data in SAP or major ERP systems.
* Proven experience project-managing complex supplier business reviews, aligning diverse stakeholder feedback, and tracking post-review action items.

**Preferred**

* Experience with CLM / VMO tooling and supplier-management systems.
* Exposure to software-contract and licensing arrangements, including EULA review for security/legal risk.
* M&A contract-review experience, including triaging acquired vendor contracts and coordinating legacy software terminations.
* Familiarity with contingent workforce onboarding procedures, Length of Service policies and vendor engagement compliance.
* Relevant industry credentials: CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager), CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management), PMP, or Lean Six Sigma.
* Direct experience with M&A contract integrations, software deprovisioning, and contingent labor regulations.

title: AML QA Specialist, Swedish, Account Compliance Quality
description:
**Description**
The Compliance Quality team is looking for a Swedish speaking quality control specialist to join a team of quality specialists covering the Know Your Customers program. The role is critical to ensure that Amazon’s payments businesses expand with appropriate controls and quality processes in place, minimizing risks and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
  
  
This quality control specialist role will join a team, who are responsible for auditing and reporting of "high-complexity" AML operational work across Amazon's payment entities and licenses. The Account Compliance Quality Auditor will work closely with operations teams and the AML program teams (both first line of defense teams) as well as occasionally with the compliance officers of the various entities (second line of defense).
  
  
The role will require performing AML quality audits on behalf of the Account Compliance Quality team, as well as delivering coaching and training to the operations teams.
  
  
The quality control specialist will be an independent individual contributor, with effective problem-solving skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Perform AML quality audits on behalf of the Quality Assurance Team.
* Partner with operational teams to deliver quality findings and support ongoing improvement opportunities.
* Provide AML quality audit subject matter expertise to business and operations teams during meetings, workshops, and leadership reviews.
* Create and update guidance and program documents.
* Conduct a variety of investigation and audit types including suspicious activity, sanctions, and enhanced due diligence.
* Share industry expertise through audits and provide written, professional feedback.
* Apply an analytical and detailed thought process to various product types and services within an AML construct.
* Assist with linking policies, standard operating procedures, internal controls, monitoring, and reporting with the goal of improving operations, compliance policies, and risk management

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of previous AML or Compliance experience
* Knowledge of compliance, EU AML and KYC-related laws, and other relevant regulations
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
* Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish
* Experience handling confidential information

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional certification such as CAMS, CRCM, or CRP
* Language certification from internationally recognised institution
* Master's degree in Compliance, Risk or Business

title: Software Development Engineer II, Fintech TAX - RoW Compliance
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Financial Technology team is seeking passionate, results-driven, and inventive software developers who thrive in working on massively scalable and distributed systems. The ideal candidate excels in a fast-paced environment, understands how to handle large data sets and transactions, and will contribute to delivering a new generation of software leveraging Amazon Web Services. With a passion for technology and a desire to tackle real-world business challenges, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in our platform, which serves Amazon's finance, tax, and accounting functions globally. As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document, and support massively scalable, distributed real-time systems. Utilizing C++, Python, Java, object-oriented design patterns, distributed databases, and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements. We seek individuals with a range of experience, from brilliant and motivated new college graduates to seasoned technical leaders with battle-tested wisdom and scars. If you can think big, aspire to join a fast-moving team breaking new ground at Amazon, and meet the qualifications, we would be delighted to engage with you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned software engineer to take on a pivotal role in the architecture, design, implementation, and deployment of large-scale, critical, and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture skills to the limit by owning all aspects of end-to-end solutions through full-stack software development. Leveraging agile methodologies, you will iteratively build and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment. With strong verbal and written communication abilities, self-motivation, and a collaborative mindset, you will work across Amazon engineering teams and business teams globally to plan, design, execute, and implement this new platform across multiple geographies. Throughout the project lifecycle, you will review requirements, design services that lay the foundation for the new technology platform, build new interfaces, integrate with existing architectures, develop and test code, and deliver seamless implementations for Global Tax customers. In a hands-on role, you will manage day-to-day activities, participate in designs, design reviews, and code reviews with the engineering team. Utilizing AWS technologies such as EC2, RDS/DynamoDB/RedShift, SWF, S3, and QuickSight, you will build backend services and customer-facing APIs. You will design and code technical solutions using tools such as Angular JS, React, Node.js, JQuery, and SQL Server to deliver value to tax customers. Additionally, you will contribute to a suite of tools hosted on the AWS infrastructure, working with a variety of tools across the spectrum of the software development lifecycle.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with Tax teams to gain a deep understanding of their business challenges, adapt swiftly to evolving needs, and align your efforts with customer priorities. You should possess the ability to act with agility, rapidly develop solutions, create proofs of concept (POCs), and provide customers with the right recommendations. A key aspect of your responsibilities will involve working closely with peer engineers, actively contributing to the design of solutions, conducting thorough deep dives, and participating in quality code reviews. Additionally, you will share the responsibility of owning and resolving operational tickets alongside your peers, ensuring efficient and effective issue resolution. This position demands a proactive mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions tailored to the specific requirements of Tax teams and their customers.
  
  
**About The Team**
The FinTech RoW Tax Compliance team oversees the Tax Data Warehouse platform, a large-scale data platform and reporting solution designed for indirect tax compliance across Amazon and other organizations. This platform enables businesses to adhere to mandatory tax regulations, drive data accuracy, and ensure audit readiness, providing consistent and reliable data to tax teams in the MX regions. As Amazon expands its operations in MX and other countries, the RoW Compliance team plays a crucial role in delivering mandatory tax reporting obligations, facilitating these launches. Furthermore, their charter encompasses building solutions to meet evolving tax legislation changes, audit requests, and technology requirements globally, such as Recon. The team is also investing in building the next generation of strategic platforms such as Unified tax ledger(UTL).
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Material Compliance Engineer
description:
**Purpose of the Role:**

The Senior Engineer - Material Compliance will play a key role in strengthening Olympus’s global material governance and compliance capability. This role is responsible for ensuring that all products meet global materials regulatory requirements (e.g., REACH, RoHS, PFAS, TSCA, MDR), managing materials-of-concern (MoC) data, and supporting cross-functional teams in responding to internal and external inquiries related to material compliance and EPP data. The incumbent will help build and implement material compliance frameworks, standardized processes, and data management tools to improve responsiveness, minimize business risk, and support long-term material strategy and innovation. This role collaborates with R&D, QARA, Supply Chain, Procurement, and external suppliers to enable compliant material selection and disclosure throughout the product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the development and maintenance of Material Compliance policies, procedures, and playbooks to ensure consistent global practices.
* Manage and validate material declaration data (CAS numbers, regulatory status, supplier disclosures) across medical device portfolios to ensure compliance with global regulations (REACH, RoHS, PFAS, TSCA, Prop 65, MDR, etc.).
* Support creation and governance of the Olympus Materials of Concern (MoC) List, including updates based on regulatory changes and industry trends.
* Drive proactive gap assessments for MoC/EPP data, identifying missing data and coordinating corrective actions with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for material compliance inquiries from regulatory authorities, customers, and internal teams, ensuring accurate, timely, and audited responses.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, QARA, Procurement, and Supply Chain to integrate material compliance requirements into design, supplier engagement, and quality systems.
* Monitor global regulatory developments and assess impacts on existing and future products, advising stakeholders on compliance risk and mitigation strategies.
* Maintain material compliance data systems, dashboards, and reporting tools to enable transparency, traceability, and audit readiness.
* Facilitate training and awareness sessions for internal stakeholders on material compliance requirements and best practices.
* Extract and manage BOM data across PLM and ERP systems including Agile PLM, ProLima, SAP, and NX Teamcenter to support compliance assessment activities.

**Person Specification:**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering,
* Master’s degree or advanced certification in relevant disciplines are preferred.

Experience

* 2 to 8 years of experience in Material Compliance, Product Stewardship, Regulatory material compliance, or related engineering roles within medical devices or other highly regulated industries.
* Hands-on experience managing compliance with global materials regulations, including but not limited to REACH, RoHS, MDR, PFAS, TSCA, Prop 65, POP, CMR, ED, and similar frameworks.
* Experience performing material compliance gap assessments, identifying missing or incomplete MoC/EPP data, and driving closure through internal teams and suppliers.
* Proven experience responding to internal, customer, and regulatory inquiries related to material compliance and environmental product data.
* Working knowledge of medical device quality and regulatory systems, including ISO 13485, MDR requirements, and integration of material compliance into design controls and lifecycle management.
* Experience collaborating cross-functionally with R&D, QARA, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Suppliers.
* Familiarity with material compliance data systems and tools (e.g., BoM Check, Assent, iPoint, PLM/ERP compliance modules) and managing large, complex datasets.
* Experience working in a global or international business environment, supporting multiple regions and stakeholders preferred.

Skills

* Strong technical background in R&D engineering disciplines.
* Excellent problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to assess risk and recommend practical solutions.
* Strong technical reading and writing skills, with the ability to interpret regulatory text and translate it into clear, actionable requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to create high-quality technical reports, summaries, and compliance documentation for internal and external audiences.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet tight deadlines with strong follow-through and accountability.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to value diverse perspectives and experiences, and to establish trust and mutual respect when working with stakeholders across functions, cultures, and geographies.
* Effective communicator capable of engaging technical and non-technical audiences with clarity and confidence.
* Comfortable operating in matrixed, international teams and navigating ambiguity in evolving regulatory environments.
* Ability to work well in a team environment.
* Independent and detail oriented.

* Monitor, analyze, and communicate developments in Indian labor and employment laws, regulations, and court decisions, including emerging requirements under the Labour Codes and other employment-related legislation.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain employment-related agreements and documents, including offer letters, employment agreements, restrictive covenant agreements, separation documents, contractor agreements, and employment policies.
* Advise on employee lifecycle matters, including hiring, performance management, disciplinary actions, accommodations, investigations, leaves of absence, employee relations issues, and terminations.
* Partner with HR and business leaders to support workforce initiatives, organizational changes, restructurings, policy implementation, and compliance programs.
* Conduct legal research and provide clear, actionable recommendations on complex or novel employment law issues.
* Manage relationships with external counsel and coordinate legal advice on specialized employment, labor, compliance, and litigation matters.
* Support employment-related disputes, government inquiries, audits, investigations, and litigation by gathering facts, assessing risk, and developing legal strategy.
* Develop and deliver training and guidance to HR professionals and business leaders on employment law obligations and best practices.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of policies, processes, templates, and controls designed to promote legal compliance and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with Legal, Ethics & Compliance, Privacy, and other corporate functions on matters involving workplace compliance, investigations, data protection, and regulatory requirements.

**What You Will Need:**

* Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) and qualification to practice law in India; additional legal credentials or certifications are a plus.
* 15+ years of experience practicing employment and labor law, preferably with a leading law firm, multinational corporation, or a combination of both.
* Deep knowledge of Indian employment and labor laws, including employee relations, disciplinary processes, terminations, wages and benefits, social security requirements, workplace investigations, and workplace harassment obligations.
* Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating employment-related agreements, policies, and other legal documents.
* Demonstrated ability to identify legal risks and provide practical, business-oriented solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong legal research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience advising senior business leaders, HR professionals, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts to non-legal audiences.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different geographies, functions, and levels of the organization.

**What Would Be Nice To Have:**

* Experience supporting multinational organizations with global or regional employment law matters.
* Familiarity with the implementation and ongoing developments relating to India's Labour Codes and other evolving employment law reforms.
* Experience conducting internal investigations and advising on employee misconduct, whistleblower, ethics, or workplace concerns.
* Exposure to corporate compliance programs, including policy development, training, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance initiatives.

title: Employee Relations Specialist - Triage and Appeals
description:
**Job Summary**

The International Investigations & Appeals Triage Specialist serves as the secondary intake, assessment, and assignment resource for employment-related allegations and appeals across international regions. The role is responsible for evaluating incoming concerns, determining investigative merit, assessing risk, ensuring appropriate escalation of sensitive matters, and assigning cases to the most suitable region/investigator. The Specialist partners closely with Investigative and Appeals Organizations and regional stakeholders to ensure investigations are managed consistently, objectively, and in accordance with company policies and governance standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Conduct secondary review and assessment of allegations received through various reporting channels, including Alert Line, Open Door, management referrals, and other intake sources.

• Evaluate whether allegations present a reasonable basis for investigation and determine appropriate case disposition.

• Identify and escalate significant, high exposure matters, high-risk concerns, sensitive employee relations issues, and potential conflicts of interest.

• Assign cases based on subject matter expertise, complexity, risk level, geographic scope, and investigator availability.

• Ensure investigation records meet established data quality standards, including accurate issue categorization, participant identification, and documentation.

• Research related cases and relevant employee information to support effective case assignment and investigation planning.

• Partner with HR, Legal, Employee Relations, Labor Relations, Ethics & Compliance, and investigative teams to ensure timely and appropriate case handling.

• Support governance reporting, trend analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives related to investigative intake and triage processes.

• Maintain strict confidentiality while exercising sound judgment and discretion in managing sensitive matters

• Performs similar duties for Appeals process as well

**Minimum Qualifications**

**•**
Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business, Law, Compliance, Industrial Relations, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in Employee Relations, Workplace Investigations, Human Resources, Compliance, Legal Operations, or Risk Management.

• Experience evaluating employee complaints, misconduct allegations, or workplace concerns.

• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.

• Experience working with case management systems and confidential information.

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA in human resources, Business, Employment Law, or related discipline.

•SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, CCEP, or equivalent professional certification.

• Experience supporting workplace investigations across multiple countries and jurisdictions.

• Knowledge of employment law, labor relations, employee investigations, ethics, and compliance programs.

• Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, Case IQ or similar enterprise alert line and case management systems.

title: Tax Compliance Program Manager, Tax and Account Compliance
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a Tax Compliance Program Manager to support the First Line of Defense (1LoD) for EU/UK tax compliance across Amazon’s Marketplace business. In this role, you will execute against defined risk workstreams, support governance processes, and deliver control activities arising from EU and UK tax regulations. Working within established risk frameworks and under the guidance of senior programme leaders, you will contribute to ensuring the business operates within clearly defined risk appetite and compliance standards.
  
  
You will support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax compliance risks across Amazon’s Global Selling ecosystem. This includes executing operational controls aligned to EU/UK regulatory requirements, maintaining risk documentation, tracking programme deliverables, and escalating emerging risks through appropriate channels. You will monitor regulatory developments and assess their operational implications, contributing analysis that informs programme-level decisions.
  
  
Your focus will be on maintaining preventative controls, supporting data integrity across tax and identity systems, and producing audit-ready documentation. Working cross-functionally with Legal, Policy, Product, Tax, and Data Science partners, you will execute against programme plans, support the resolution of systemic issues, and contribute to risk-based control frameworks. You will ensure compliance activities within your workstreams are proportionate, risk-calibrated, and delivered on time and to the expected quality bar.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own defined workstreams within EU and UK tax compliance programmes, delivering risk assessments and control activities on time and to quality standards
* Execute risk assessments using established methodologies, documenting findings clearly and escalating issues that exceed defined thresholds
* Analyze EU/UK tax compliance regulations (e.g., VAT, DAC7, JSL, Deemed Reseller) and their implications for Amazon sellers, translating requirements into actionable deliverables
* Support the development and maintenance of risk models and detection mechanisms to identify non-compliant or fraudulent seller behaviour related to tax obligations
* Collaborate with legal, policy, finance, tax, tech, and product teams to execute programme plans and deliver operational controls for new and existing programmes
* Track key risk indicators (KRIs) and programme metrics, producing status reports and flagging deviations to programme leadership
* Prepare risk assessments, programme updates, and supporting materials for senior leadership reviews
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of risk and programme processes

A day in the life
  
  
You are joining a global team spread across the US, EU, Japan, and India. You will partner closely with a Tax Governance manager in the UK and collaborate heavily with Risk teams based in India and the EU to ensure Amazon’s compliance controls are in the best possible working order.
  
  
Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, and stakeholder coordination across multiple time zones. One morning you are reviewing control effectiveness with the 2nd Line of Defence; the afternoon you are in a working session with EU 3P Marketplace partners assessing the impact of a new VAT regulation on sellers. The next day you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review or troubleshooting a data integrity issue with tech partners in Seattle.
  
  
No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent
* 5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* 2+ years of program or project management experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience using lean process improvement, six sigma methodologies, or related performance metrics/process improvements to increase efficiency within processes, forecasting, planning, optimization, or logistics
* Knowledge of knowledge of VAT in EU/UK
* Master's degree or equivalent
* - Experience in tax, regulatory compliance, or financial services risk management

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**Purpose**
Establish and own the analytics and technical reporting capability within Core Compliance. This senior individual contributor combines analytics engineering depth with the judgement to set direction, translate complex Compliance processes into dependable data products, and drive delivery across organisational boundaries.
  
  
The role adds dedicated technical expertise and hands-on delivery capacity to extend what Group Compliance can monitor, analyse and report.
  
  
Working closely with the CCSDE Lead and other relevant leads, this person will establish the Core Compliance analytics repository and delivery approach in line with wider Wise analytics best practices. They will own implementation for Core Compliance systems and tools where capability or capacity gaps exist, and lead the coordination of changes that require delivery by established analytics or Engineering teams.
  
  
**Scope**
The role owns the technical quality and delivery of the analytics assets established within its agreed Core Compliance remit. Other analytics and Engineering teams retain their existing responsibilities for shared platforms, datasets and wider analytics delivery. Changes to those capabilities are agreed and implemented with their owners.
  
  
Existing analytics teams retain their request-collection processes. This role works within Group Compliance to identify and deliver capability improvements and provide senior technical engagement on analytics issues.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Own the technical foundations for Core Compliance analytics
  
  

* Design and establish the Core Compliance repository and analytics delivery setup, working with Engineering and analytics partners on the use of dbt, Airflow, Snowflake and Lightdash within the existing Wise environment.
* Make and document design decisions for models, transformations, orchestration and reporting: source selection, data grain, keys, historical changes, refresh dependencies and recovery behaviour.
* Establish GitHub development and review practices, automated checks, release procedures, access arrangements and documentation aligned with wider standards. Ensure the setup can support multiple use cases and be maintained by others.
* Agree the interfaces, dependencies and support responsibilities with the teams that own shared infrastructure and upstream datasets.

Deliver and operate models pipelines and reporting
  
  

* Write SQL and dbt models, implement workflow orchestration in Airflow, and build reporting in Lightdash on Snowflake for systems and tools within the Core Compliance remit.
* Take work through discovery, design, implementation, validation, release and ongoing improvement. Exercise technical judgement on when to reuse an existing capability, extend a local model or coordinate an upstream change.
* Address practical engineering concerns such as incremental processing, historical accuracy, duplicate or late data, safe reprocessing and query performance where they affect the use case.
* Define and implement checks for completeness, accuracy, freshness and reconciliation, together with actionable failure notifications and documented recovery procedures for the components owned by Core Compliance.
* Investigate issues through the data flow, resolve defects within the role's ownership and work with upstream owners on source or platform issues.

Develop trusted metrics and actionable analysis
  
  

* Create ad hoc analysis, reports, dashboards and metrics across CCSDE and CMT, connecting the output to the monitoring, oversight or operational decision it needs to support.
* Translate process concepts such as reporting deadlines, ownership, workflow status, ageing and completion into explicit metric definitions and data models. Account for exceptions and changes over time.
* Validate analytical results against source records, explain material limitations and ensure that colleagues can understand and use the outputs with confidence.
* Establish reusable definitions and reporting assets where needs recur, with documented lineage, ownership and quality expectations. Retain the ability to answer new questions quickly through focused analysis.

Set priorities and lead delivery across teams
  
  

* Identify the most valuable gaps in Core Compliance's monitoring and reporting capability and develop a prioritised delivery roadmap with the relevant leads.
* Act as the principal Core Compliance contact on analytics issues, bringing the technical understanding needed to establish scope, resolve unclear ownership and agree implementation approaches with partner teams.
* Drive dependencies and cross-team decisions through to delivery. Make trade-offs between immediate analytical needs, maintainability and partner capacity, and communicate their implications clearly.
* Coordinate updates and implementations owned by other teams while remaining accountable for defining the Core Compliance need and validating that the resulting capability meets it.

Apply AI and agentic workflows with technical judgement
  
  

* Use approved AI tools and agent harnesses in analytics and development workflows, including SQL and dbt development, test generation, documentation, data investigation and review.
* Develop useful GitHub-based working practices and agentic workflows that improve delivery speed and consistency, with clear review, testing and access boundaries.
* Evaluate generated code and analytical outputs against source data and expected behaviour. Assess the practical benefit of these workflows and share effective approaches with colleagues.

**Qualifications**
**What you will bring**

* Advanced SQL and strong data-modelling skills, with evidence of personally delivering reliable analytical models, pipelines and reporting used in operational decisions.
* Substantial hands-on experience with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks, orchestration such as Airflow, and a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake. Ability to work effectively across the target stack, including Lightdash.
* Experience establishing or materially improving an analytics repository and delivery process, including GitHub collaboration, testing, review, deployment and documentation.
* Technical depth in data quality, troubleshooting and performance, with the ability to explain design choices and their consequences rather than relying on tool familiarity alone.
* A track record of taking ambiguous business problems through to implementation, setting priorities and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders without relying on reporting-line authority.
* Strong analytical judgement: defining meaningful metrics, validating evidence and communicating findings and limitations clearly.
* Applied knowledge of AI-assisted analytics, agent harnesses and agentic development workflows, including how to verify outputs and use them responsibly in a collaborative environment.

**Bonus Experience**
Experience with Core Compliance, monitoring and testing, regulatory reporting workflows, or incident and breach management. Familiarity with data products that support controls, evidence, retention and access requirements is valuable. Financial Crime experience is an additional benefit where relevant to the work.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Critical data products have clear owners, documented definitions and measurable reliability expectations.
* An agreed technical design, Core Compliance repository and working development process aligned with wider Wise analytics best practices, with clear ownership and partner interfaces.
* An initial priority pipeline or model operating reliably, supported by tests, documentation, failure handling and an agreed maintenance approach.
* A set of trusted reports, dashboards and metrics addressing material needs across CCSDE and CMT, with definitions validated by the relevant users.
* A prioritised roadmap and effective delivery arrangements with partner teams, demonstrating increased monitoring and reporting capability within Core Compliance.

title: Senior Solicitor
description:
**SENIOR SOLICITOR | REAL ESTATE & LEGAL STRATEGY**

Hyderabad | Full Time | Leadership Role

**An opportunity to bring experience, judgement and legal excellence to real estate leadership.**

MPM Group, a Hyderabad based real estate development company, is seeking an exceptionally experienced legal professional to head its legal function and serve as Principal Counsel to the Chairman & Managing Director.

This is a senior strategic position for a distinguished legal professional with deep expertise in real estate transactions, property law, litigation strategy and complex legal documentation. This is a full-time, advisory and strategic role at our Hyderabad corporate office. Court appearances remain with external counsel.

Retired judges and highly experienced legal professionals with a strong background in real estate and property law are particularly encouraged to apply.\*

**THE ROLE**

**Real Estate Transactions & Legal Documentation**

* Structure and negotiate land acquisitions, Joint Development Agreements, development cum GPA arrangements and revenue sharing agreements.
* Draft and vet Sale Deeds, Agreements of Sale, GPAs, lease deeds, RERA compliant buyer agreements and project financing documents.
* Lead legal negotiations with landowners, investors, lenders and buyers.

**Title Due Diligence & Risk Assessment**

* Conduct comprehensive 30-year title searches and chain of title verification.
* Examine Encumbrance Certificates, Pahani, ROR, Sethwar and Bhu Bharati records.
* Identify and assess legal risks involving assigned lands, Inam lands, land ceiling restrictions, endowment properties and prohibited lands.
* Provide robust title opinions suitable for institutional financing and investor due diligence.

**Regulatory & Revenue Matters**

* Advise on land mutation, conversion under NALA, stamp duty and registration.
* Guide compliance with Telangana RERA and applicable HMDA and GHMC regulations.

**Litigation Strategy & Legal Advisory**

* Develop legal strategies for property disputes, title suits, writ petitions, arbitration and RERA proceedings.
* Brief and supervise external advocates and review pleadings before filing.
* Undertake legal research and provide strategic opinions on complex matters.

**Legal Leadership & Governance**

* Establish and lead an effective in house legal function.
* Develop standardized legal documentation, review protocols and matter tracking systems.
* Leverage AI and legal technology to improve the efficiency and quality of legal drafting, research and review.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in real estate and property law, including at least five years in a leadership role.
* Experience with a real estate developer, reputed law firm or institutional legal panel.
* Strong command of property transactions, litigation strategy, title verification and legal drafting.
* LL.B. from a recognized university. LL.M. preferred.
* Fluency in English and Telugu.
* Distinguished legal professionals with substantial judicial or advisory experience and a strong understanding of real estate law are encouraged to apply.
* Compensation will be commensurate with experience and seniority. For the right candidate, compensation will not be a constraint.

MPM Group values diversity in leadership. Women legal professionals are strongly encouraged to apply.

**INTERESTED IN THIS OPPORTUNITY?**

**Please send your CV and a cover letter explaining your suitability for the role to:**

**hr@mpm.in**

title: Senior Risk Analyst
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Senior Risk Judgment & Advisory**

* Serve as the senior analytical authority for complex, high-tier risk cases — including Cyber Risk, AI risk, cross-jurisdictional privacy complexity, and novel technology types not clearly addressed by existing framework
* Provide risk advisory support to IT leadership, BISOs, Legal/Privacy, and business stakeholders — translating complex risk landscapes into clear, actionable guidance
* Own the integrity of the risk determination record for high-profile or sensitive programs; provide independent review where risk signals are ambiguous or where determinations carry material business or regulatory consequence
* Guide analysts on when to accept, challenge, escalate, or override risk outputs — serving as a calibration resource and quality anchor for the team

**Framework Stewardship & Continuous Monitoring**

* Monitor patterns across risk assessments — override rates, exception volumes, flag frequencies — to identify systematic accuracy issues, framework gaps, or emerging risk themes
* Support continuous monitoring initiatives and contribute to the evolution of BMS's integrated risk framework (Scope Screening → Regulatory Classification → Risk-Tiered Controls) as the operating model matures
* Identify where the risk tiering model, control library, or assessment logic may need refinement; articulate improvement recommendations with supporting evidence to Risk Leads and leadership
* Contribute to periodic reviews of auto-approved projects, leading structured assessments where findings may have broader programmatic implications

**Stakeholder Leadership & Cross-Functional Engagement**

* Lead engagement with senior project sponsors, IT architects, Legal/Privacy SMEs, and Compliance teams on high-risk or high-complexity assessments
* Represent the IT Risk function in cross-functional forums; provide subject matter expertise on regulatory risk implications (GDPR, EU AI Act, GxP, NIST frameworks)
* Build and maintain strong partnerships across IT, Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, and Business functions; act as a trusted advisor rather than a compliance gatekeeper
* Support escalation resolution between Risk Leads, BISOs, Privacy SMEs, and project teams; facilitate closure on disputes involving risk determinations and framework interpretation

**Operational Excellence & Governance**

* Ensure audit-ready documentation standards across the team; review and validate complex SNOW and GRC records for accuracy, completeness, and audit defensibility
* Contribute to or lead training initiatives for analysts on evolving framework components, updated risk tiering logic, and operational workflow changes
* Support governance reporting; prepare executive-quality risk summaries, trend analyses, and control attestation packages for senior leadership and compliance audiences
* Provide UAT support for framework and tooling updates — including validating that risk outputs align with expected SME-level determinations

**Mentorship & Team Development**

* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior analysts; support calibration, quality review, and professional development within the team
* Model the expected analyst behavior in an automation-enabled environment: review-first, judgment-driven, override with rationale, and escalate with clarity

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–10 years of progressive experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity risk, IT audit, privacy compliance, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated track record of independent, senior-level risk judgment — including experience handling complex, ambiguous, or high-stakes risk determinations
* Deep knowledge of NIST Cyber Risk Management Framework, NIST 800-53 controls library, and at least one major privacy regulatory framework (GDPR, EU AI Act, GxP, CCPA)
* Experience working with GRC platforms at an advanced level (ServiceNow GRC or equivalent); ability to review, validate, and ensure quality of records produced by others
* Strong executive communication skills; experience preparing and presenting risk findings to senior leadership or audit/compliance audiences
* Experience with AI/ML, automation, or emerging technology risk programs — including digital transformation and data privacy risk governance

**Desired Candidate Characteristics**

* Highly developed risk judgment — able to form defensible, well-reasoned positions on complex determinations and explain them clearly to any audience
* Advisory mindset: seen as a trusted partner by stakeholders, not just a process owner
* Comfortable with automation and system-generated risk signals as primary inputs — focused on interpreting and acting rather than manually gathering data
* Strategic thinker with an eye on where the risk function is heading, not just where it is today
* Strong influencer and collaborator; able to drive alignment across Legal, Privacy, IT, and Business without formal authority

title: Cyber Risk & Compliance Analyst
description:
At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Senior IT Compliance Specialist is a hands-on, globally oriented role responsible for translating regulatory, customer, and internal security requirements into sustainable controls, defensible evidence, and audit-ready operations. The position partners across security, legal, business, support, engineering, infrastructure, and cloud teams to advance compliance outcomes without creating unnecessary operational friction.
  
  
This role is designed for an experienced practitioner who can independently lead workstreams, influence control owners, communicate with auditors and customers, and improve the way compliance work is scoped, documented, monitored, and automated.
  
  
**Role mandate**
Make compliance executable: clarify scope and ownership, design practical controls, maintain evidence, anticipate change, and keep priority programs ready for assessment throughout the year.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Compliance leadership and program delivery**

* Lead and manage IT compliance initiatives to ensure adherence to internal policies, standards, contractual obligations, and applicable international or government security frameworks.
* Own assigned workstreams from requirement intake and scoping through control mapping, gap assessment, remediation, evidence readiness, and ongoing governance.
* Maintain compliance strategies, roadmaps, and operating plans that align security requirements with business priorities, technology architecture, and delivery commitments.
* Establish clear accountability with business owners, IT asset owners, and control owners; track decisions, risks, dependencies, and remediation commitments to closure.

**Assessments, certifications, and audit readiness**

* Drive certification and assurance efforts by coordinating internal audits, external assessments, customer reviews, risk assessments, and security documentation submissions.
* Plan and facilitate readiness activities for ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, TISAX, NIS2, and other requirements assigned to the team.
* Coordinate requests with assessors and third-party auditors, validate the completeness and quality of evidence, and ensure responses are accurate, consistent, and traceable.
* Manage findings and corrective actions using a risk-based approach, including root-cause analysis, remediation planning, validation, exception handling, and status reporting.
* Promote continuous readiness by defining evidence expectations, review cadences, health indicators, and escalation paths rather than relying on point-in-time audit preparation.

**Control design, implementation, and monitoring**

* Interpret framework and regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, testable control objectives, control activities, evidence requirements, and ownership models.
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, application, cloud, security operations, identity, data, and support teams to embed controls into technology processes and system lifecycles.
* Assess control design and operating effectiveness, identify gaps or duplicated effort, and recommend practical remediation that balances risk, compliance, and operational needs.
* Support continuous monitoring through defined metrics, automated evidence collection, exception reporting, and periodic control reviews.
* Contribute to reusable control mappings and a unified control approach to reduce duplication across overlapping frameworks and customer obligations.

**Documentation and stakeholder support**

* Maintain and enhance System Security Plans (SSPs), Information Security Management System, policies, standards, procedures, control narratives, risk assessments, plans of action, evidence repositories, and governance records.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on IT compliance, advising internal teams on scope, control expectations, audit evidence, risk treatment, and compliance-by-design.
* Support customers, contracting stakeholders, and Authorizing Officials (AOs) by providing approved compliance documentation and clear guidance for security evaluations.
* Prepare concise status reports, risk statements, decision materials, and executive updates that distinguish confirmed facts, open issues, ownership, and required action.
* Develop practical guidance and targeted training for control owners and technical teams to improve execution quality and audit readiness.

**Regulatory intelligence and process improvement**

* Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Procurement, Internal Audit, Security, and business stakeholders to validate interpretations and convert changes into actionable implementation plans.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring compliance activities, streamline evidence collection, improve workflow quality, and reduce manual or duplicative work.
* Use lessons learned, audit results, metrics, and stakeholder feedback to improve control design, documentation quality, governance, and team operating practices.
* Perform other responsibilities or special assignments as requested by leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in IT compliance, IT audit, cybersecurity governance, technology risk, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience leading compliance assessments, audits, certifications, or regulatory readiness efforts in a complex, multinational technology environment.
* Working knowledge of several of the following: ISO 27001/27002, NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, TISAX, NIS2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOC reporting, IT general controls, or comparable security frameworks.
* Experience translating requirements into control designs, test procedures, evidence expectations, risk statements, and remediation plans.
* Experience creating or maintaining compliance documentation such as SSPs, policies, standards, procedures, control narratives, risk assessments, and audit evidence packages.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, organize complex information, meet deadlines, and escalate material risks or dependencies with sound judgment.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, technical disciplines, and time zones.
* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, cybersecurity, computer science, accounting, risk management, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certification such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISM, or a comparable credential.
* Experience supporting cloud or hybrid environments, regulated data, government contracting obligations, automotive assurance, or European cybersecurity requirements.
* Experience with governance, risk, and compliance platforms; workflow automation; data visualization; scripting; or automated evidence collection.
* Familiarity with third-party risk, privacy, Responsible AI governance, mergers and acquisitions, or customer security assurance.
* Experience supporting distributed teams through clear documentation, structured handoffs, measurable service expectations, and overlapping working hours when required.

**Indicators of Success**

* Assigned compliance obligations are clearly scoped, mapped to accountable owners, and supported by current documentation.
* Assessments and audits are executed with timely, accurate, and traceable evidence and minimal avoidable rework.
* Control gaps, risks, exceptions, and remediation actions are transparent, risk-prioritized, and progressed to closure.
* Compliance requirements are embedded earlier in technology, sourcing, and change decisions.
* Recurring work becomes more standardized, measurable, automated, and sustainable across the global delivery model.

**Work Style and Collaboration Expectations**
The successful candidate is proactive, structured, pragmatic, and comfortable operating with a high degree of independence. Because the role supports global stakeholders, the individual must be able to manage priorities across time zones, document decisions and handoffs clearly, protect confidential information, and maintain dependable communication during agreed collaboration windows. Occasional schedule flexibility may be required for audits, customer discussions, incidents, or regulatory deadlines.

title: Process Lead / Assistant Manager - Environmental compliance
description:
**About CleanHarbors**
Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6 billion company. Clean Harbours was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO.
  
  
Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.
  
  
Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Product Compliance Process Lead/Assistant Manager/Manager**
will be responsible for leading and executing the organization's product compliance program in alignment with all applicable
**environmental, health, and safety regulations**
. This role will oversee compliance strategies related to
**customer equipment, labelling, solvent chemistry, and safety data documentation**
while ensuring adherence to industry and regulatory requirements.
  
  
This position requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement compliance best practices, maintain documentation, and develop training programs. The role will
**manage teams, drive continuous improvement initiatives**
, and ensure compliance with federal, state, and international product regulations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Compliance Leadership & Strategy:
* Ensure health, safety, and environmental compliance as the top priority by developing and implementing compliance frameworks, policies, and procedures.
* Provide strategic direction to ensure regulatory adherence across all product compliance activities.
* Lead audits, assessments, and risk analysis to identify gaps and enhance compliance processes.
* Serve as the key point of contact for regulatory agencies and external stakeholders on compliance matters.
* Regulatory Compliance & Documentation:
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and review of Safety Data Sheets (SDSs), labels, and product documentation in compliance with OSHA, GHS, REACH, and other global regulatory requirements.
* Ensure that all branch operating guidelines (BOG), best management practices (BMP), and standard operating procedures (SOP) are up to date and implemented effectively.
* Coordinate product registration, environmental compliance reporting, and regulatory impact assessments.

**Team Leadership & Training**

* Lead, train, and develop a team of compliance professionals within the Global Capability Center (GCC) to support compliance initiatives.
* Design and implement training programs for employees and stakeholders on product compliance, safety standards, and environmental regulations.
* Act as a mentor, fostering a culture of continuous learning and regulatory excellence within the team.
* Process Improvement & Technology Enablement:
* Leverage technology to streamline compliance data storage, retrieval, and analysis for global accessibility.
* Drive process improvements in compliance tracking, reporting, and documentation management.
* Identify emerging compliance trends and recommend enhancements to existing policies and procedures.
* Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration:
* Partner with facility compliance managers, product support teams, and leadership to drive compliance initiatives.
* Work closely with Regulatory, Legal, R&D, and Operations teams to align compliance programs with business goals.
* Support facility operations by coordinating OSHA’s Hazard Communication standards with the Global Harmonized System (GHS).
* Reporting & Governance:
* Oversee the preparation of compliance reports and maintain accurate workpapers, documentation, and audit trails.
* Ensure compliance assurance programs align with federal, state, local, and provincial laws, as well as corporate policies.
* Monitor global regulatory changes and assess their impact on company products and processes.
* Other Responsibilities:
* Assist in corporate compliance initiatives, offering guidance and expertise as needed.
* Perform additional duties as assigned to support business and regulatory objectives.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
* 5+ years of experience in product compliance, regulatory affairs, or environmental health & safety (EHS), with at least 2+ years in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
* Strong knowledge of EPA, OSHA, GHS, REACH, and other regulatory frameworks.
* Proven experience in leading compliance programs, audits, and risk management initiatives.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to analyze regulations, assess business impact, and drive strategic compliance initiatives.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Experience with compliance-related software tools and data management systems is a plus.
