title: Regional Security Advisor, Asia Pacific
description:
**Reports To:**
Director, Global Security & Investigations
  
  
**Position Summary**
Asia Pacific is one of the most dynamic and complex operating environments in the world, shaped by geopolitical tension, rapid economic change, natural hazards, and varied regulatory and cultural landscapes. As the senior security leader for the region, you will define and drive a security vision that protects our people, manufacturing footprint, assets, and reputation while enabling the company's growth ambitions.
  
  
You will be a strategic partner to regional and country leadership, shaping decisions on market entry, site selection, expansion, and risk appetite. You will translate global security strategy into a regional program that is mature, measurable, and adapted to each country. You will also build the organization, partnerships, and resilience that make the company a secure and credible presence across the region. This is a role for a leader who thinks at enterprise scale and can operate both at the boardroom table and on the plant floor.
  
  
**You Will Be Responsible For**
**Strategic Vision & Enterprise Risk Leadership**

* Defining and owning a multi-year Asia Pacific security strategy and roadmap, aligned to global priorities and integrated with regional business plans
* Anticipating geopolitical, economic, criminal, civil unrest, terrorism, and climate-related risks, and translating them into clear strategic guidance and scenario planning for senior leadership
* Leading regional risk assessments and turning the findings into prioritized, risk-based investment decisions for people, travelers, facilities, and assets
* Advising on the security implications of major business decisions, including market entry, acquisitions, divestitures, site selection, and supply chain footprint
* Contributing regional insight and thought leadership to the global security strategy, helping shape enterprise policy, standards, and investment priorities

**Resilience, Crisis & Incident Leadership**

* Owning regional crisis management, business continuity, and emergency preparedness, including governance, exercises, and a culture of continuous improvement
* Serving as the senior security lead during significant incidents, guiding executive decision-making, coordinating cross-functional response, and escalating to the Director, Global Security & Investigations
* Ensuring lessons from incidents and after-action reviews become lasting improvements to the program
* Overseeing sensitive investigations, the travel security risk program, and executive protection, with appropriate discretion and independence

**Program Ownership & Organizational Capability**

* Owning the regional implementation of global security policies and standards, defining metrics that demonstrate effectiveness, maturity, and value
* Partnering with the Global Security Operations Support Team to drive enterprise-wide standardization and technology-enabled solutions
* Building and leading the regional security organization as the program matures, including setting direction, developing talent, and providing oversight for those responsible for security at manufacturing plants and other facilities
* Managing regional security budgets, vendors, and service providers to deliver strong outcomes and value

**Executive Influence & Ecosystem Leadership**

* Serving as the principal security advisor to regional, country, and facility leadership, earning trust as a strategic partner rather than a control function
* Partnering with HR, Legal, and Compliance & Ethics to deliver integrated, multidisciplinary guidance on complex, high-stakes matters
* Building and leading a network of relationships with host-country government agencies, law enforcement, industry bodies, and the multinational public/private security community
* Representing the company as a credible, well-connected voice on security across Asia Pacific

**What You Bring**

* 15+ years of progressive security management experience, preferably in Asia Pacific, including leadership of regional or multi-country programs
* Demonstrated responsibility for security in an environment outside your home country or country of primary residence (required)
* Experience in a large multinational company or an equivalent public/government sector (required)
* Proven ability to influence and advise senior executives, and to lead and inspire teams without relying on formal authority
* Strong strategic and geopolitical acumen, with the ability to turn complex risk into clear business decisions
* Experience building or maturing a security function, including talent, governance, and metrics
* Manufacturing sector experience (preferred)
* CPP, PSP, PSI, or equivalent certification (a plus)

title: Core Compliance Systems, Data & Enablement (CCSDE) Senior Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**Purpose**
Support the CCSDE Lead in delivering reliable, effective Compliance workflows through Compliance systems. The CCSDE Lead sets design and engineering direction; this role translates that direction into tested workflow changes, dependable access administration and responsive support for Compliance officers.
  
  
The role takes ownership of day-to-day execution within agreed designs and controls, identifies recurring problems and helps improve how Compliance teams use Compliance systems.
  
  
**Scope**

* Deliver Compliance systems workflow and automation changes. Configure workflows, fields, forms, routing and business rules under the CCSDE Lead's design direction. Clarify requirements, identify dependencies, execute business acceptance testing and document results before release. Maintain the workflow and automation register, including business purpose, owner, dependencies, last test date and fallback process. Identify unused or duplicate workflows for retirement.
* Execute Compliance access management. Run joiner, mover, leaver and periodic access recertification processes across relevant Core Compliance systems. Maintain approval and completion records. Coordinate privileged access requests with UT and Privacy under agreed controls, escalating exceptions to the appropriate owner.
* Maintain documentation and the knowledge base. Keep runbooks, wikis, troubleshooting guidance and process documentation current. Review content for staleness and ensure documentation is updated alongside material releases.
* Support Compliance officers using Compliance systems. Act as the first point of contact for user and process questions, including form selection, known workarounds, access queries and initial investigation of workflow or business-rule issues. Capture reproducible evidence and escalate technical defects or platform issues to UT. Track resolution times, recurring themes and adoption issues.
* Deliver training and change communication. Prepare user guidance, onboard Compliance officers and communicate workflow changes to affected regional teams. Support training and adoption for AI agents used by Compliance, following approved guidance.
* Contribute to maintaining the regional feedback network. Coordinate regional champions or equivalent contacts, gather feedback and identify work happening outside established systems. Translate findings into clear improvement proposals for the CCSDE Lead.
* Contribute operational and access data. Provide accurate information to the Data, Metrics & MI Forum when relevant, including support trends, access activity and workflow adoption.

**Decision rights**
The role owns execution within agreed designs, priorities and access controls. Design decisions, material exceptions and changes to control requirements are escalated to the CCSDE Lead or the relevant control owner.
  
  
P1 - Compliance systems, workflow and controls
  
  

* Workflow and automation configuration changes: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery, under the Lead's design direction.
* Business acceptance testing: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.
* Workflow and automation register maintenance: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.

P3 - Access, systems and knowledge governance
  
  

* Joiner, mover, leaver and access recertification execution: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.
* Documentation, runbooks and staleness reviews: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.

P5 - Operations, enablement and regional experience
  
  

* Compliance officer support: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.
* Compliance systems and AI agent training and change communication: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.
* Regional feedback and tracking work outside established systems: The CCSDE Lead is accountable. The Compliance Systems Senior Specialist is responsible for delivery.

**Qualifications**
**What you will bring**

* Practical experience configuring and supporting workflow, case-management or service-management systems, including forms, routing, permissions and automation rules.
* Ability to translate user needs into clear requirements, test scenarios and maintainable configuration changes.
* A structured troubleshooting approach: reproduce issues, examine evidence, distinguish configuration problems from platform defects and escalate clearly.
* Experience executing controlled operational processes, maintaining accurate records and handling access or other sensitive requests carefully.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining system behaviour to non-technical users and producing usable documentation.
* Ownership of assigned work, sound prioritisation and judgement about when to act independently and when to seek guidance.
* A collaborative approach to feedback and continuous improvement.
* Useful additional experience: Compliance or regulated operations; Jira or comparable workflow tooling; basic SQL or operational reporting; user training; and supporting the adoption of approved AI tools.

Additional Information
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Compliance System changes are tested, documented and delivered predictably. Access requests and reviews are completed with clear evidence. Compliance officers receive useful support, recurring issues inform improvements, and regional teams can use established workflows confidently.
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: Deputy / Assistant Manager (Government Partnership)
description:
**Job Title: Deputy / Assistant Manager (Government Partnership)**

**Location: Hyderabad, Telangana**

**Travel: As per the project need**

**Position Overview:**

This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with the Dept of School Education, Samagra Shiksha, Telangana Skill Education component as part of a dedicated Project Management Unit (PMU). The Assistant/ Deputy Manager will lead school based skill education reforms across the state, working directly with senior bureaucrats (including IAS officers) on Skill Education strengthening, managing co-ordination between National & State level Institutions in Education & Skilling domain, policy implementation & Tech & Data based governance improvement. Based in Hyderabad, the role combines strategic exposure, scale based execution and high-impact work in India’s skilling & education ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Govt & Stakeholder Engagement

* State & Central Ministry: Facilitate co-ordination between State School Education dept (Samagra Shiksha) & other Central institutions: Ministry of Education, NCVET, PSSCIVE, SSCs etc under established State & Centre channel for Samagra Shiksha based Skill Education delivery in schools
* Inter-State Depts: Facilitate coordination between Dept of School Education (Samagra Shiksha), SCERT, State Board, Dept of Skill Development & other relevant departments for School based Skill Education delivery support

2.School based Skill Education Delivery Facilitation at State Level

* Skill Education Delivery as per Scheme & Policy: Facilitate Skill Education delivery in Govt Schools at Scale in alignment with CSSVSE scheme, NEP-NCF mandate & State Vision for Skill Education for thousands of schools (Grade 6-12)
* Facilitate design & delivery of System setup in Schools: e.g-Skill lab setup in Schools, Skill Education Books delivery, Internships for School Students, AI integration in Skill Education curriculum etc
* Facilitate sufficient govt budget allocation to Skill Education in coordination with State School Education dept & Ministry of Education

3. Teacher Onboarding, Capacity Building

* Vocational Teacher Onboarding Facilitation: Support onboarding and management of vocational training partners (VTPs) & Vocational Teachers/ Trainers (VTs).
* Training: Coordinate Vocational/ Skill Education teacher training, Training of Trainers (ToT) and master trainer development.
* Support development of training resources and capacity-building systems.

4.Tech & Data Based Governance Improvement- Monitoring

* Facilitate effective monitoring through State based Monitoring platform; Monthly District & VTP review meeting; keeping IAS/State officers updated on progress through data & reports
* Prepare progress reports and analytical presentations for program reviews
* Facilitate large data collection from govt schools, analytics & outcome reporting to IAS & other senior officials for timely decision making around Skill Education

5. Drive Student Outcome

* Facilitate Students Internships (Grade 11-12), Career Counselling, Job Fairs, Higher Education pathways by planning & designing intervention at the State level
* Facilitate delivery of the same in schools as per State budget & program allocation

6. Team Management-PMU

* Manage PMU Team at State level
* Guide & Mentor all PMU team members of the State

7. PMU Operations & Government Coordination

* Support day-to-day functioning of the Skill/Vocational Education PMU at Samagra Shiksha, School Education Dept
* Coordinate with senior officers, including IAS and State Services officers, for meetings, reviews, and follow-ups
* Prepare briefing notes, presentations, concept notes, and action trackers for senior bureaucrat/IAS leadership
* Track meeting outcomes, decisions, and implementation timelines

8. Reporting & Documentation

* Prepare periodic progress reports, and presentations
* Maintain records of PMU activities, meetings, and outputs
* Ensure professional communication between Lend A Hand India and Government counterparts

9. Support to all LAHI’s Projects in Telangana: Need based support to other LAHI’s projects in Andhra Pradesh (SCERT, State Board, Skill Development Dept)

**About Lend A Hand India :**
Lend A Hand India (LAHI) is a leading national Think Tank/Non Profit Organisation with over 20 years of experience in strengthening India’s skill and vocational education ecosystem. LAHI works closely with 20+ State and UT governments through long-term partnerships, providing technical advisory and Project Management Unit (PMU) support to drive systemic reforms. In Telangana, LAHI partners with the Dept of School Education, Samagra Shiksha to support large-scale improvements in school based Skill Education (6-12) delivery. Currently, In 20+ States 22,000+ schools and 25 lakh + students are supported by LAHI through 300+ team members working Pan-India.

**Our Mission**

Equip School Students to Maximise Their Potential Through Skill Education

**Our Approach**

* Direct implementation in schools
* Partnership with central-state governments to define, and scale policy
* Building of Centres of Excellence that act as lighthouses for innovation
* Resource organisation for the skilling ecosystem

**Our Knowledge in Action**

Through the design & execution of innovative models from training centres, innovation hubs to mobile outreach initiatives, LAHI’s innovative knowledge resource drives both grassroots learning and systemic transformation across India. With 250+ LAHI staff embedded in state education systems across 20+ states, we provide technical and project management support, enabling governments to translate policy into action.

**Our Reach**

LAHI’s current scale of work includes -

* 20+ States and UTs
* 15000+ Schools
* 15 Lakh+ Students
* 250+ Team Members

**What Truly Sets a Career at Lend A Hand India Apart –**

* **Work as a Systems Architect, not just an Implementer:**
  You help build and refine the system itself, influencing policy and creating lasting change.
* **Experience the thrill of scale with depth:**
  See your ideas and efforts replicated across thousands of schools, impacting millions of students in a measurable way.
* **Master Complex Collaboration:**
  Gain unparalleled experience navigating and synergizing the worlds of government, corporate CSR, and community.
* **Career with a Tangible Legacy:**
  Your work directly creates skilled professionals, confident entrepreneurs, and a stronger national economy.
* **Investment in you:**
  We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive support & robust benefits and a culture that actively champions your professional development and holistic well-being.

**Minimum Experience:**

* Overall experience of 5-10+ years in Education & Govt PMU Management
* Prior experience of Education/Skill Development
* Prior experience of working with State level Senior bureaucrats/ IAS (preferred)
* Experience of relevant fellowship desirable (Education/Skilling: Gandhi, TFI, MGNF etc)
* Prior experience working with State or Central Government departments preferred

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Public Policy, Education, Management, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Relevant fellowships (e.g., MGNF, Gandhi Fellowship, TFI, etc.) will be an added advantage

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Language: Excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & Telugu
* Team management: Experience of Managing team, Ability to lead State PMU and manage/guide team members who are part of PMU
* Technical Skills: Experience of developing strategy & documentation for IAS/State level Govt officials use: State level presentations for Senior Bureaucrats; Policy/Guideline Drafts; Notesheets; Concept Notes, SOPs; tender work-technical support etc
* Ability to manage Govt projects at State level (notesheets, tender work-technical support, desk research work, orientation to senior officials about project details)

* Proficient in drafting official letters, note sheets, proposals, concept notes, SOPs, making presentations etc. (preferred)
* Proficient in large data analytics (excel & google sheet based) & presenting the findings via great visual presentation & report to senior officials
* Good understanding of India’s School Education system

**Personal Attributes:**

* Detail-oriented, proactive, and solution-focused
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Strong sense of responsibility and teamwork

title: Practicing Advocate
description:
⚖️
**HIRING: CORE LITIGATION ADVOCATE | HYDERABAD | EXCLUSIVE PROFESSIONAL ENGAGEMENT**

**Jurisiti Legal LLP, a Delhi-based litigation law firm, is looking to engage an experienced Core Litigation Advocate in Hyderabad to independently manage and represent the firm's litigation matters across the region.**

**As part of our regional expansion, we are looking for a competent, strategically minded, and professionally committed advocate who can take ownership of litigation matters, independently develop case strategies, handle court proceedings, and ensure effective coordination with our central team in Delhi.**

**With a team of 12+ in-house advocates and a wider professional network**
, we are strengthening our regional litigation capabilities through long-term professional associations with experienced advocates who bring strong legal knowledge, courtroom confidence, independent judgment, and a results-oriented approach to litigation.

This opportunity is intended for a litigation professional who values professional stability, responsibility, continuity of work, and the opportunity to build a long-term association with a growing law firm.

🔹 POSITION DETAILS

📍
**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana

⚖️
**Position:**
Core Litigation Advocate

🤝
**Engagement Model:**
Exclusive, long-term professional engagement

💰
**Remuneration:**
Monthly remuneration, commensurate with experience and capabilities

🏛️
**Firm Headquarters:**
Delhi, with regional litigation operations

🔹 1. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS

The candidate should possess the following qualifications and experience:

* A minimum of
  **5–6 years of post-qualification experience (PQE)**
  in core litigation practice.
* An LL.B. degree and a Master's degree in Law (LL.M.).
* Both LL.B. and LL.M. qualifications from
  **Tier-1 law institutions**
  .
* Substantial practical experience in court proceedings, legal research, drafting, filing, oral advocacy, and end-to-end management of litigation matters.
* The ability to independently analyse disputes, assess legal risks, formulate litigation strategies, and take responsibility for assigned matters.
* Strong knowledge of substantive law, procedural law, judicial precedents, and court practice.

🔹 2. PRACTICE AREAS

The candidate should have practical experience and professional exposure in the following areas:

* **Civil Litigation**
* **Commercial Litigation**
* **Business and Contractual Disputes**
* **Consumer Litigation**
* **Labour and Employment Matters**
* **Arbitration and Dispute Resolution**
* **Criminal Litigation**

**The primary focus of this engagement will be Civil and Commercial Litigation.**

**Candidates should have demonstrable experience in handling civil and commercial disputes, preparing pleadings and applications, managing procedural requirements, conducting hearings, and advancing arguments before the appropriate courts and tribunals.**

**Experience across the other practice areas will be valuable, particularly where matters require coordinated, multidisciplinary litigation support.**

🔹 3. INDEPENDENT LITIGATION STRATEGY & COURTROOM ADVOCACY

We are looking for an advocate who can think independently, analyse a case critically, and develop a clear, practical, and legally sustainable strategy.

The selected professional should be capable of:

* Independently examining case facts, documents, evidence, and applicable legal provisions.
* Identifying the strengths, weaknesses, risks, and opportunities associated with a dispute.
* Developing a well-reasoned strategy to pursue the client's legitimate interests effectively.
* Conducting in-depth legal research and identifying relevant statutes, judgments, and judicial precedents.
* Drafting high-quality plaints, written statements, petitions, replies, applications, affidavits, written submissions, and other litigation documents.
* Managing filing procedures, court deadlines, procedural requirements, and hearing preparation.
* Presenting persuasive oral arguments and responding effectively to questions and objections raised during proceedings.
* Anticipating opposing arguments and preparing appropriate legal responses.
* Evaluating interim relief, procedural remedies, settlement possibilities, and further legal options.
* Advising on litigation risks and recommending suitable next steps based on the facts and applicable law.

**We seek a professional who can take ownership of a matter from its initial assessment through the relevant stages of litigation, rather than merely execute instructions or attend hearings.**

**The ability to develop an independent legal strategy while remaining aligned with the firm's broader case objectives will be central to this role.**

🔹 4. COURT ORDER COMPLIANCE & END-TO-END MATTER MANAGEMENT

Effective litigation requires more than courtroom appearances. It requires systematic management of judicial directions, procedural obligations, documentation, and deadlines.

The selected advocate must be capable of independently managing these responsibilities, including:

* Reviewing and analysing court orders following hearings.
* Identifying directions requiring action, compliance, documentation, or further filings.
* Tracking deadlines and ensuring timely completion of procedural requirements.
* Preparing and coordinating applications, replies, affidavits, and other compliance-related documents.
* Monitoring hearing dates, case status, interim directions, and subsequent action points.
* Keeping the firm's central team informed about orders, developments, risks, compliance requirements, and recommended next steps.
* Maintaining accurate case records and ensuring continuity in the handling of assigned matters.
* Taking proactive steps to minimise avoidable procedural delays and prevent matters from being overlooked.

We value professionals who demonstrate accountability, procedural discipline, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

🔹 5. EXCLUSIVE ENGAGEMENT & MONTHLY REMUNERATION

This opportunity is designed for an advocate seeking a
**structured, long-term, and exclusive professional association**
with our firm.

The selected candidate will receive monthly remuneration under mutually agreed engagement terms and will be expected to devote the agreed professional capacity to the firm's assigned matters and regional responsibilities.

The engagement will involve:

* Dedicated handling of the firm's assigned litigation matters within the agreed scope.
* Consistent coordination with the central team in Delhi.
* Timely reporting of hearing outcomes, court orders, case developments, and next steps.
* Professional management of assigned responsibilities and deadlines.
* Compliance with mutually agreed confidentiality, reporting, and matter-management arrangements.
* A sustained commitment to building the firm's litigation capabilities in the region.

We are looking for someone who values continuity of work, predictable monthly remuneration, long-term professional collaboration, and the opportunity to contribute to an expanding legal practice.

The precise remuneration, workload, scope of exclusivity, and other engagement conditions will be agreed mutually, subject to applicable professional regulations.

🔹 6. REGIONAL REPRESENTATION & LITIGATION PRACTICE DEVELOPMENT

The selected advocate will serve as the firm's principal litigation professional for Hyderabad and the surrounding region within the agreed scope of engagement.

Key responsibilities will include:

* Managing and representing the firm's assigned matters before appropriate courts and tribunals, subject to applicable enrolment, practice, and procedural requirements.
* Independently handling assigned matters while coordinating with the firm's central team in Delhi.
* Communicating effectively with clients and relevant stakeholders in a professional and confidential manner.
* Coordinating with briefing counsel and other legal professionals wherever required.
* Preparing regular case updates, hearing reports, status summaries, and strategic recommendations.
* Maintaining organised matter records and ensuring appropriate documentation and procedural compliance.
* Supporting the development of a dependable regional litigation practice through consistent professional standards and execution.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently while remaining connected to a larger team, shared systems, and common client-service expectations.

🔹 7. LOCAL LANGUAGE & REGIONAL COURT FAMILIARITY

Familiarity with
**Telugu and English**
, local court procedures, regional litigation practices, and communication with clients and other stakeholders in Telangana will be an added advantage.

Practical familiarity with the local legal environment and experience appearing before courts and tribunals in Hyderabad and the surrounding region will also be valuable.

🔹 8. THE PROFESSIONAL WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* Strong legal reasoning, analytical ability, and independent judgment.
* Excellent drafting, research, and oral advocacy skills.
* A strategic approach to litigation and dispute resolution.
* The ability to manage cases with minimal supervision.
* Professional integrity, accountability, and respect for confidentiality.
* Discipline in managing deadlines, court orders, and procedural compliance.
* Clear communication and effective coordination with a central legal team.
* A collaborative mindset and genuine interest in a long-term professional association.

We are looking for someone who takes litigation seriously, prepares thoroughly, thinks strategically, and accepts responsibility for the matters entrusted to them.

**The objective is to build a reliable regional litigation practice led by a professional who can combine legal expertise, independent decision-making, and disciplined execution.**

🔹 HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated résumé through either of the following channels:

📧
**Email:**
contact@jurisiti.com

**📱 WhatsApp:**
+91 97173 29850

Please mention
**“Core Litigation Advocate – Hyderabad”**
in the email subject line or WhatsApp message.

title: Manager Pharma Compliance
description:
**Job Purpose**

To provide compliance oversight and ensure effective management of regulatory adherence across retail and wholesale pharmacy operations for the assigned region. The role acts as the regional custodian of compliance, assisting in the procurement and management of requisite licenses, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements, and tracking any deviations via periodic store audits.

**Qualification**

D.Pharm / B.Pharm/M Pharm

**PQE**

3 - 5 Yrs

**Description of Responsibility**

**Compliance**

* Assist in the procurement, management, and timely renewal of requisite drug licenses and statutory registrations.
* Conduct periodic store audits on various parameters, ensuring compliance under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, Pharmacy Act, Teleconsultation guidelines, Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, Drug Price Control Order (DPCO), NDPS Act, Legal Metrology Act, etc.
* Maintain registers and records, tracking validity of the licenses and post-registration compliances & license conditions.
* Ensure compliance with legal requirements under various enactments and internal policies.

**Inspections, Notices & Documentation**

* Be the first responder for FDA / drug inspector inspections. Be present on site or coordinate it and ensure records are inspection-ready.
* Prepare responses to show cause notices, deficiency letters and other regulatory correspondence, in coordination with Legal and the Senior Director.
* Identify gaps from audits and inspections, document findings, and drive CAPA to closure within timelines.
* Maintain a centralised, up-to-date repository of all regional licences, notices and correspondence.
* Report periodically to the Senior Director on compliance health, open notices and risks.

**Government & Stakeholder Relationship Management**

* Liaise closely with CDSCO, State Drug Control Departments (FDA), health ministries, and other local regulatory bodies. Visit offices when required to follow up on licences, inspections and notices.
* Build and maintain professional, ethical working relationships with government and law enforcement officers.

**Desired Skills**

* Deep, functional knowledge of Indian pharmaceutical laws, drug pricing orders and telemedicine regulations.
* Working knowledge of state-specific licensing processes and FDA practices in the region.
* Proven experience handling inspections and show cause notices, and managing licensing vendors or consultants.
* Strong audit acumen, attention to detail and a strategic approach to compliance and risk.
* Willingness to travel across the region for audits, inspections and government visits.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English and the local language is preferred.

**Competency**

* **Reliability, dependability:**
  Works hard and does what it takes to get results and meets deadlines. Takes accountability and works well in a cross-functional team.
* **Communication:**
  Writes, speaks, and presents information effectively, clearly, and with brevity. Confidently communicates with government officials and internal staff.
* **Composure:**
  Handles unexpected events calmly and acts with the highest level of professionalism and maturity during crisis situations.
* **Dealing with ambiguity:**
  Works effectively in situations involving uncertainty; effectively handles multiple projects or tasks at the same time.
* **Company-wide perspective:**
  Able to assess the broader and deeper impact of compliance decisions, focusing on what is right for the overall business.

**External Stakeholder Management**

* Appoint, manage and review external vendors such as licensing consultants, audit and pharmacy-compliance agencies, and local counsel.
* Validate and process vendor’s work, and escalate delays or lapses.

title: Senior Manager - FCU
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Manager - Financial Crime Unit (FCU) to oversee and strengthen our financial crime prevention and detection frameworks. In this pivotal leadership role, you will be responsible for managing investigations into money laundering, fraud, terrorist financing, and other illicit financial activities. You will lead a team of dedicated specialists, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards, mitigating organizational risk, and safeguarding the company's integrity and assets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* \*\*Strategic Leadership:\*\* Design, implement, and continuously improve the organization’s Financial Crime Unit policies, procedures, and monitoring frameworks.
* \*\*Investigation Management:\*\* Oversee complex financial crime investigations, ensuring they are conducted thoroughly, ethically, and in accordance with regulatory requirements.
* \*\*Regulatory Compliance:\*\* Ensure timely and accurate filing of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) / Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other mandatory regulatory filings.
* \*\*Team Leadership:\*\* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of financial crime analysts and investigators, fostering a culture of continuous learning and vigilance.
* \*\*Risk Mitigation & Reporting:\*\* Identify emerging financial crime trends, conduct regular risk assessments, and present comprehensive compliance reports and actionable insights to senior leadership.
* \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration:\*\* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk Management, and external law enforcement agencies to address potential threats and resolve complex cases.

**Qualifications And Requirements**

* \*\*Education:\*\* Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.
* \*\*Experience:\*\* Minimum of 7–10 years of experience in financial crime investigation, AML compliance, or forensic accounting, with at least 3 years in a managerial or leadership role.
* \*\*Certifications:\*\* Professional certification such as Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) is highly desirable.
* \*\*Technical Skills:\*\* Deep understanding of AML/CFT regulations, Sanctions compliance, and hands-on experience with financial crime monitoring and detection technologies.
* \*\*Analytical & Communication Skills:\*\* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, coupled with strong written and verbal communication skills for presenting to executive stakeholders and regulators.

Any Graduates

Job Title: Executive – Statutory Compliance Department: Human Resources / Compliance

Experience: 2–4 Years

Location: Hyderabad

Reporting To: Manager – HR Payroll & Statutory Compliance

Employment Type: Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Executive – Statutory Compliance to manage and ensure timely compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements across multiple locations. The role involves handling PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, minimum wages, contract labour compliance, statutory returns, audits, documentation, and coordination with internal teams, clients, and government authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Ensure timely compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements across multiple locations.

· Handle monthly PF and ESIC activities, including ECR preparation, challan generation, payment tracking, employee registration, and exit updates.

· Manage Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), and other applicable statutory payments and returns.

· Monitor compliance with Minimum Wages, Payment of Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, Maternity Benefit, and other applicable labour legislations.

· Handle Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act compliance, including registration, licensing, renewals, and related documentation, wherever applicable.

· Manage Shops and Establishments registration, renewals, amendments, and statutory records.

· Prepare, review, and maintain statutory registers, returns, challans, acknowledgements, and supporting documents.

· Coordinate with clients, internal HR teams, payroll, finance, vendors, and statutory authorities for compliance-related activities.

· Conduct statutory compliance audits, identify non-compliances, and ensure timely closure of observations and corrective actions.

· Monitor compliance portals and client audit platforms, ensuring timely submission of documents and closure of non-compliances.

· Support inspections, notices, and other queries from statutory authorities by preparing the required documents and coordinating responses.

· Track statutory due dates, maintain compliance calendars, and ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and annual filings.

· Verify employee and payroll data to ensure accuracy of statutory contributions and payments.

· Prepare compliance reports, MIS, and periodic status updates for management and clients.

· Keep updated on amendments to labour laws, minimum wages, and other applicable statutory requirements.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

· Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline.

· 2–4 years of experience in statutory compliance, labour law compliance, payroll compliance, or HR operations.

· Good knowledge of PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Minimum Wages, CLRA, Shops and Establishments, and other applicable labour laws.

· Hands-on experience with statutory portals, compliance trackers, and audit documentation.

· Proficiency in MS Excel, including data validation, reconciliation, and MIS reporting.

· Strong coordination, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.

· Ability to manage multiple locations, meet statutory deadlines, and work with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Skills**

· Experience in managing PAN-India statutory compliance.

· Familiarity with compliance management platforms such as Comply4HR/C4HR, Lawrbit, MYND, UCS, or Simpliance.

· Experience in client compliance audits, documentation reviews, and non-compliance closure.

· Knowledge of payroll systems such as Keka and statutory reconciliation processes.

**Key Competencies**

· Attention to detail and accuracy.

· Deadline management and follow-up.

· Problem-solving and analytical skills.

· Ownership and accountability.

· Effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a resourceful and driven professional to join DESRI, based out of the firm’s Hyderabad, India office. The successful candidate will be a part of a growing, inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar and battery projects in an agile environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you’ll support DESRI’s project finance workstream and partner closely with a dynamic commercial team. Working alongside deal teams, asset managers, lenders, tax equity and equity investors, and attorneys in other DESRI offices, you will:
  
  

* Support financing transactions across the portfolio, including construction-to-term conversions, refinancings, acquisitions.

* Prepare closing checklists, certificates, resolutions, and conditions precedent packages that support each financing across the development, construction, and operating phases of our solar, wind, and storage projects.

**Qualifications**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured review guidelines and escalation protocols, with a demonstrated capacity for tracking multiple deliverables and compliance requirements across concurrent transactions.
* Proficiency in MS Word and Excel, with experience using legal technology tools, including AI-based platforms and document automation systems, or demonstrated willingness and aptitude to quickly learn such tools.
* Ability to work effectively with US-based legal, finance, and deal teams, and with external lenders and counsel, in a cross-border environment.

The Financial Fraud team's vision is to protect customers and Amazon financials from exposure to bad actors, thus disincentivizing and reducing their attempts to operate in our stores.

As the first India-based counsel at Unseen Realities, you will work independently and will be the India law and market expert for the Analog legal team. At the same time, you will be a full member of the Analog legal team, working closely with and supported by your colleagues in the Abu Dhabi office.

The successful candidate will take end to end ownership of Indian corporate law and governance, company secretarial processes, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and the management of Unseen Realities’ interests in its India joint venture and its participation in wider Analog group arrangements, which together form the core of the role. This is a unique opportunity to shape key business decisions and drive Analog’s growth within a fast evolving technology market in India.

In this highly visible role, you will also lead intellectual property licensing and technology transactions in India, ensuring the protection and proper use of Analog’s intellectual property in customer, supplier and joint venture-facing arrangements, safeguarding Analog’s legal interests while fostering strategic relationships with our partners, as Analog expands its portfolio of physical intelligence-driven products into India.

You will also oversee legal risk management, employment matters, disputes, and legal operations, including the supervision of external counsel and the project management of legal matters across the business.

**What You’ll Do**

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will own a broad range of legal matters, with a critical focus on Indian corporate law and governance, corporate processes, joint venture management, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and a working understanding of intellectual property and technology transaction issues.

You will:

**India corporate law, governance and corporate actions**

* Own, with support from external company secretarial providers where appropriate, all corporate and company secretarial processes for Unseen Realities, including convening board and shareholder meetings, preparing agendas, notices, board and shareholder resolutions, circulation resolutions and minutes, and supporting board / committee governance processes.
* Manage key corporate actions, including share issuances and transfers, dividends and other distributions, amendments to the constitutional documents, maintenance of share capital and shareholding records, and the creation and satisfaction of charges.
* Manage director and officer appointments, resignations and removals, including director identification number (DIN), know your customer (KYC) requirements and related filings.
* Oversee the maintenance of statutory registers, statutory filings, and the compliance calendar under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Coordinate exchange control and foreign investment reporting for inbound investment into Unseen Realities and for any joint venture shareholding, including FC-GPR / FC-TRS filings, and downstream investment reporting under the Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments) Rules 2019, working with the authorized dealer bank and external counsel where required.

**Commercial contracting**

* Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including master services agreements, technology and software arrangements, intellectual property licenses, supplier and subcontractor terms, procurement and services agreements, non-disclosure agreements, data processing / privacy terms, and customer facing terms.
* Review and negotiate channel, reseller, distribution, system integrator, consortium and joint bidding arrangements, including arrangements entered into in order to respond to requests for proposal, public procurement processes, and tenders in India.
* Provide legal expertise on memorandums of understanding (MOUs) and partnership agreements, and advise business stakeholders on contractual risk, liability, and compliance considerations.
* Develop and maintain Indian law contract templates, playbooks and fallback positions for use across the business, streamlining the contracting process and reducing reliance on external counsel.

**Analog group and joint venture arrangements**

* Manage Unseen Realities’ interests in its India joint venture or partnership arrangements, including the exercise of its rights and the performance of its obligations under any joint venture or shareholders’ agreements and joint venture constitutional documents, reserved matter approvals, delegation of authority implementation, and support for the directors and shareholder representatives appointed by Unseen Realities.
* Negotiate and administer the corporate and commercial arrangements between Unseen Realities and its joint venture partners or joint venture entities, and between Unseen Realities and other Analog group companies, including product sales agreements, intellectual property licenses, branding arrangements, technology arrangements, and services arrangements, in each case on arm’s length terms.
* Coordinate with your colleagues in the Analog legal function on Analog group corporate governance and related party transaction requirements.

**Regulatory, risk management and compliance**

* Provide legal advice on Indian regulatory matters and ensure that all agreements and business activities comply with applicable Indian laws and regulations, including the Companies Act, 2013, exchange control and foreign investment rules, data protection under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, labour and employment laws, competition law, anti-bribery and anti-corruption legislation, and sector-specific regulations, as applicable.
* Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of compliance programs and internal policies, including adapting the Analog group’s compliance and other policies to address local law deviations where necessary.
* Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate legal and compliance risks to protect Analog’s business in India.
* Monitor legal and regulatory developments in India to assess impact on the business.

**Intellectual Property and licensing**

* Advise on intellectual property ownership and manage intellectual property licensing arrangements in India, ensuring the protection and proper use of the Analog group’s intellectual property, including in customer, partner and joint venture facing contracts.
* Manage, through external agents, Indian trade mark, patent, copyright and design filings and prosecution, and manage brand use, enforcement, and domain name issues.

**Legal operations, cross functional collaboration and management of external counsel**

* Work closely with your colleagues in the Analog legal function and with the India business to ensure that legal considerations are aligned with business strategies and embedded into business operations.
* Instruct and manage Indian external counsel, company secretarial providers and other advisers, ensuring cost effective and comprehensive legal support and control of legal spend.

**Employment and HR legal support**

* Advise the Analog People team on employment matters, including hiring, terminations, disciplinary matters, investigations and employee relations, coordinating with external legal counsels for specialist or sensitive matters.
* Draft and review employment contracts, consultant and contractor agreements, policies, and internal guidelines.

**Litigation and dispute management**

* Manage and oversee, with external counsel, litigation, arbitration, regulatory matters, notices, and pre-litigation correspondence in India.
* Develop dispute-resolution strategies aligned with business objectives and escalate material disputes to the Analog CLO and relevant business stakeholders.

**What You’ll Bring**

* LL.B. or B.A. LL.B. from a recognized Indian university, or an equivalent legal degree enabling enrolment with a State Bar Council in India.
* Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE), with demonstrable depth in both (i) Indian corporate law and processes, including board and shareholder matters, corporate actions and statutory filings, and (ii) commercial contracts governed by Indian law.
* Strong background in contract negotiation, regulatory compliance, risk management, and external counsel management, including budget and performance oversight.
* Ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical business advice in support of business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to work independently as, initially, the sole legal resource based in India, and to collaborate as part of a geographically distributed team in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
* Qualified to practice law in India, including enrolment with a State Bar Council under the Advocates Act 1961, whether current or suspended for the duration of full time salaried employment.
* Based in Hyderabad, or willing to relocate to Hyderabad, and able to work from the offices of Unseen Realities. Ability to travel within India, and occasionally internationally, as business needs require, would be helpful.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior in-house experience, preferably in a technology business.
* Experience advising an India subsidiary or India joint venture of a foreign-headquartered or multinational group.
* Strong experience in Indian intellectual property law, particularly intellectual property licensing, ownership, brand use, and India market technology transactions.
* Strong working knowledge of technology law, data protection, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and the regulatory framework applicable to technology businesses in India, including procurement and tendering by government and public sector customers.
* Experience of joint venture governance, including exchange control and downstream investment requirements.
* Experience advising on AI-related legal issues and understanding of the ethical, regulatory, and commercial implications of AI.
* Proven ability to manage complex legal projects and advise senior stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
* High level of integrity, judgment, discretion, and professionalism.
* Experience of company secretarial processes, and of working with company secretaries, registrars and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal filings.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or Telugu, in addition to English, would be an advantage but is not essential.

**What Working at Analog Offers**

**Culture:**
A collaborative, globally minded team building the future of physical intelligence. We value curiosity, courage, and creativity, and we’re united by a belief that technology should amplify human potential rather than replace it.

**Impact:**
The opportunity to work on projects with national and global significance, from adaptive cities and resilient infrastructure to next generation sports, entertainment, healthcare, and energy. Every product you help build contributes to shaping a safer, smarter, more human centered world.

**Growth:**
Outstanding opportunities for learning and career development. You’ll collaborate with leaders across AI, robotics, mixed reality, and systems engineering, while working on industry first, frontier scale solutions.

**Rewards:**
A competitive compensation package.

**Unseen Realities is an equal opportunity employer**
. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment in accordance with applicable law and without discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable laws of India.

description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
We are seeking a proactive, independent, and detail-oriented Senior Regulatory Compliance Expert to join our team of compliance officers in India. In this role, you will work independently as part of a collaborative team, focusing on the regulatory domain to consult, provide oversight, and set up and manage product and license governance.
  
  
Wise operates under multiple regulatory licenses in India (Cross-Border), requiring strong adherence to applicable payment system regulations and FEMA requirements. You will be directly responsible for driving regulatory compliance across these frameworks, overseeing obligations for existing licenses and / or leading initiatives for upcoming India license applications, updates, and regulatory restructuring as we expand our product offerings.
  
  
Your Mission & Responsibilities
  
  

* Governance Setup & Management: Propose, set up, and manage robust product and license governance frameworks to ensure continuous compliance for current and upcoming licenses.
* Regulatory Consultation & Oversight: Act as a key internal consultant, reviewing the applicability and impact of new regulations, providing oversight, and partnering with cross-functional teams on regulatory implementation.
* License Management: Support/Drive regulatory projects related to supporting license discussions, application, updates, and regulatory construct to support evolving product frameworks.
* Horizon Scanning: Perform continuous horizon scanning and maintain/update the Regulatory Obligations Register (ROR) based on the latest regulatory notifications.
* Regulatory Reporting: Independently manage regulatory reports to the Regulator(s) accurately and in a timely manner, ensuring all submissions meet strict compliance standards.
* Audits & Inspections: Lead regulatory audits, internal/external inspections, and coordinate periodic governance and stakeholder review meetings.
* Risk & Remediation: Monitor compliance risks and KPIs, proactively identify control gaps, and design and lead effective remediation plans.
* Stakeholder & Regulatory Communication’s Management: Navigate regulatory filing portals to track deliverables, respond to information requests from regulators or internal stakeholders, and securely manage all physical and digital regulatory communications.
* Global Integration: Support the implementation of global compliance projects within the Indian context and provide ad-hoc support for related Regulatory and financial crime matters or global compliance requests.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 7 to 12 years of experience in regulatory compliance, regulatory reporting, or related compliance roles, preferably within fintech, payments, cross-border remittance, or financial services environments.
* Regulatory Expertise: In-depth knowledge of the general regulatory framework in India, with proven experience monitoring and interpreting payment system regulations and FEMA requirements.
* Independent Ownership: Proven ability to work independently, act pragmatically, and successfully navigate the collaborative working culture at Wise.
* Core Skills: Strong communication, excellent organisational and time management abilities, and exceptional stakeholder management skills.
* Adaptability: Eager to adapt swiftly to a fast-paced environment and always willing to learn and implement new regulatory structures.
* Education: CA, MBA (Finance), Law Graduate, or a bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Sr. Tax Program Manager, Tax and Account Compliance
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Tax Account Compliance team is seeking a Senior Tax Program Manager to drive end-to-end program management for tax across Amazon's global Marketplace business. In this role, you will act as the embedded business risk owner, accountable for proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating tax risks. You will also translate regulatory requirements into detailed program requirements, coordinate cross-functional delivery with tech, product, legal, tax planning, operations and other partner teams, and program manage regulatory changes from scoping through to execution. At the same time, you will ensure programs are proportionate and risk-calibrated, minimizing false positives and protecting legitimate sellers while maintaining marketplace integrity.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, innovative program manager with experience building programs from the ground up, launching scalable solutions across multiple functions and organizations, and understanding seller pain points. You will raise the seller experience bar by optimizing controls, removing unnecessary friction, and reducing business impact from tax obligations. Problem-solving, program management skills, and executive communication are essential to be successful in this role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive VP/Director level goals
* Translate regulatory requirements (e.g., VAT, JSL, Deemed Reseller) into detailed program requirements, working with tech and product partners on the development of new products and functionalities
* Program manage end-to-end tax launches from scoping and requirements definition through cross-functional delivery and post-launch validation
* Coordinate cross-functionally with legal, tax, tech, product, and operations teams to deliver scalable solutions
* Raise the seller experience bar by optimizing controls, removing unnecessary friction, and reducing business impact from new and existing compliance obligations
* Identify and resolve tax issues, bottlenecks, and dependencies; own remediation plans and drive continual process simplification
* Oversee program health end-to-end and prepare program updates and recommendations for senior leadership
* Perform competitive benchmarking to ensure Amazon programs meet or exceed industry standards
* Promote a culture of compliance, proactively engaging stakeholders across business, operations, and technology teams
* Influence roadmap prioritization by clearly articulating risk exposure and business impact
* Proactively identify pain points and opportunities for continual process simplification and improvements.

A day in the life
  
  
You are joining a global team spread across the US, EU, Japan, and India. You will partner closely with Tax Governance and collaborate heavily with Risk teams to ensure Amazon's compliance controls are in the best possible working order.
  
  
Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, seller experience optimization, and stakeholder coordination. One morning you are translating a new regulation into program requirements; the afternoon you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review.
  
  
No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Experience managing projects
* Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or equivalent
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Real Estate Transaction Management
description:
**Job Description – Transaction Management (Key Accounts)**




  





**Position Summary** 




 The Transaction Management is the
 **senior strategic leader** 
 responsible for shaping, governing, and delivering the real estate transaction strategy for high‑value key client accounts across India. This role demands exceptional executive presence, a strong command of commercial real estate markets, and the capability to influence C‑suite stakeholders within client organizations and CBRE.
 



 They will function as the
 **single point of accountability** 
 for the client’s real estate portfolio performance, ensuring alignment with global corporate strategies, driving continuous optimization, and leading multi‑disciplinary teams to deliver excellence across all real estate transaction lifecycle stages.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Portfolio Ownership** 



* Define and lead the India\-wide real estate transaction strategy, ensuring alignment with regional and global CRE directives.
* Challenge and influence client leadership through data\-backed insights, scenario modelling, and long‑range portfolio planning.
* Anticipate market shifts, business expansions, regulatory trends, and commercial risks to proactively shape client’s real estate strategy.
* Drive enterprise\-level outcomes including cost optimization, footprint rationalization, portfolio resilience, and operational agility.



**2\. Executive Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as a senior strategic partner to the Client’s Corporate Real Estate (CRE) leadership and business unit heads, building trusted relationships across decision‑making levels.
* Lead key client engagement forums including business reviews, portfolio strategy sessions, governance meetings, and performance discussions.
* Ensure consistent communication, seamless service delivery, and proactive issue resolution across all touchpoints.
* Serve as the senior\-most relationship partner to the client’s leadership, building trust and influencing strategic decisions.
* Lead governance forums including quarterly business reviews, portfolio steering committees, and annual planning workshops.
* Engage with C‑suite stakeholders across Business Leadership, CRE, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Projects, Audit, and Facilities.



**3\. End‑to‑End Transaction Governance** 



* Initiate, oversee, and close transactions across renewals, acquisitions, expansions, consolidations, dispositions—ensuring strategy, risk, and compliance alignment.
* Ensure full adherence to client governance frameworks, including policy controls, audit requirements, global playbooks, and approval matrices.
* Translate client business drivers into actionable portfolio and transactional strategies.
* Lead negotiations, collaborating closely with brokerage teams, legal counsel, finance, and other internal stakeholders to secure optimal commercial and contractual outcomes.
* Provide direction and governance to brokers, third‑party partners, and Lease Documentation Specialists.
* Develop and enforce high‑performance operating models for transaction execution, documentation quality, and service consistency.
* Provide oversight for complex legal negotiations across LOIs, MOUs, lease agreements, sale deeds, and termination documents.
* Establish and maintain robust risk‑mitigation frameworks for commercial, contractual, and operational exposures.
* Drive standardization of templates, processes, governance models, and reporting formats across India portfolios.



**4\. Analytical Mindset** 



* Lead financial modelling, investment analysis, NPV/IRR assessments, portfolio benchmarking, and business case development.
* Perform market and financial analysis and ensure accurate data for each transaction, translate analytics into board\-ready recommendations.
* Partner with Finance leadership to shape the Annual Operating Plan, RE Budgets, Capital Planning, and cost‑efficiency strategies.
* Drive disciplined performance management across KPIs, SLAs, savings targets, and operational scorecards.



**5\. People Manager and Team Player** 



* Provide strategic leadership to transaction managers, analysts, and cross‑functional delivery teams.
* Partner closely with Projects, Facilities Management, Advisory \& Consulting, Research, Risk, and Legal to deliver integrated real estate solutions.
* Foster a culture of accountability, excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Mentor high‑potential talent and contribute to CBRE’s leadership development initiatives.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* **Strategic Vision** 
 : Ability to define long‑term portfolio strategies, influence C‑suite decision‑making.
* **Commercial \& Financial Acumen** 
 – Strong expertise in real estate economics, deal structuring, financial modelling, and business case development.
* **Executive Communication** 
 – Confident presenter with the ability to articulate complex insights to senior leaders.
* **Negotiation Mastery** 
 – Advanced capability in commercial negotiations and contract structures.
* **Operational Excellence** 
 – Strong focus on governance, quality control, compliance, and disciplined execution.
* **Relationship Intelligence** 
 – Skilled in navigating large, matrixed organizations and influencing without authority.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Postgraduate or bachelor’s degree in real estate, Finance, Business Administration, or related fields.
* 10 –15\+ years of progressive experience in corporate real estate, transaction management, portfolio strategy. (Mumbai – Pune – Bengaluru \- Hyderabad)
* Significant experience managing real estate for multinational occupier clients.
* Proven track record of managing senior stakeholders, large teams, and complex cross\-functional engagements.
* Ability to work effectively and lead a team in a cohesive, performance measured environment.

title: Data and AI Security Consultant
description:
**Overview**
 The EAG Security Consultant \- Data Security helps enterprise customers discover, classify, protect, govern, and investigate sensitive data across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Purview, endpoints, cloud services, and AI\-enabled workflows. The role combines hands\-on Purview delivery, consulting judgment, regulatory awareness, and secure AI adoption patterns to reduce data exposure risk, strengthen DLP effectiveness, prepare customers for Copilot and agents, and create reusable EAG Security delivery IP.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead data security discovery workshops to understand sensitive data landscape, regulatory drivers, current Purview adoption, oversharing risks, and AI / Copilot readiness blockers.
* Design and implement Microsoft Purview Information Protection capabilities including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto\-labeling patterns, and user adoption controls.
* Configure, tune, and operationalize Data Loss Prevention across Microsoft 365 workloads, endpoints, cloud apps, browsers, and AI\-related workflows where applicable.
* Assess Insider Risk Management, eDiscovery, Audit, Data Lifecycle Management, and Compliance Manager usage to improve investigation readiness and governance maturity.
* Apply DSPM and data\-security\-for\-AI patterns to identify overshared sensitive data, label coverage gaps, exposed credentials, and risky data interactions before AI rollout.
* Support Data Protection Agents and Purview agent scenarios such as sensitive data discovery, SIT recommendation, DLP triage, Purview posture assessment, and regulatory mapping.
* Create executive\-ready deliverables including posture baselines, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, policy design packs, operating procedures, and adoption recommendations.
* Contribute reusable EAG Security IP, lab guides, demos, accelerators, playbooks, and enablement content for data security delivery at scale.


**Qualifications**
 Required/Minimum Qualifications
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information protection, data loss prevention, compliance engineering, data governance, or related security consulting roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview data security capabilities, especially Information Protection and Data Loss Prevention in Microsoft 365 environments.
* Working knowledge of sensitive information types, classification strategies, sensitivity labels, DLP rules, alert triage, policy tuning, and exception handling.
* Ability to translate regulatory, privacy, and business requirements into implementable Microsoft Purview controls and customer\-facing design documentation.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance workloads including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, endpoints, Defender for Cloud Apps, audit and eDiscovery signals.
* Ability to analyze policy exports, telemetry, PowerShell outputs, and Purview reports to identify coverage gaps and remediation priorities.
* Strong communication skills for technical workshops, executive readouts, project governance, and cross\-functional collaboration with security, compliance, legal, and data teams.


**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering Purview deployments for regulated customers across DLP, MIP, IRM, retention, eDiscovery, audit, or Copilot readiness scenarios.
* Exposure to Data Protection Agents, Purview posture assessment, custom SIT discovery, DLP triage agents, DSPM, DSPM for AI, or Security Copilot in Microsoft Purview.
* Ability to design custom sensitive information types, regex\-based detection logic, policy coverage assessments, and evidence\-backed compliance mappings.
* Familiarity with data security beyond Microsoft 365, including Azure, Fabric, Snowflake, Dataverse, SAP, Salesforce, AWS, GCP, SaaS, or file\-server governance patterns.
* Experience creating reusable consulting IP such as discovery questionnaires, policy design templates, lab guides, dashboards, scripts, reports, and executive summaries.


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

description:

 The International Regulatory Lead (IRL) Manager will provide regulatory leadership \& expertise for International countries for one or more Amgen products. This role involves collaboration with various functions and local regulatory teams to
   

  

* optimize product development and regulatory approvals in International countries develop international regulatory strategy and provide regulatory support for in\-country product registrations and life cycle management.


**Job Summary**
 The International Regulatory Lead (Manager) is assigned to lead one or more Amgen products. The product(s) assigned have medium complexity programs/strategies and medium impact to Amgen.
   

  

* Provide Guidance and Leadership on mechanisms to optimize product development and regulatory approvals.
* Develop the international regulatory strategy and contribute to Global regulatory plans.
* Support regulatory product compliance (e.g. RIM, PMCs, ESC levels, and agency commitments).

* Enable efficiencies and seamless execution across the international countries.
* Contribute to process improvement projects, as assigned.


**Key Activities**
**STRATEGY AND EXECUTION**
* Advises Global teams on regulatory implications and requirements relevant to the global clinical development/Marketing Applications plans and objectives.

* Under general supervision, plans regulatory submissions (e.g. clinical trial, marketing authorization applications and lifecycle management) for products within Amgen's portfolio.

* Manages the international label submission strategy, leads the negotiation activities with cross\-functional teams and is accountable for the label deviation requests and outcomes.
* Supports Local Regulatory teams in triaging queries from health authorities, and where appropriate, help identify existing responses to same or similar questions, leveraging knowledge management.
* Advises and supports other groups on the review of promotional and non\-promotional materials, as needed.
* Supports process improvement initiatives and metrics.


**COMMUNICATION AND COLLABORATION**
* Participates as a member of the Global Regulatory Team (GRT), Evidence Generation Team (EGT), Labeling Working Group (LWG), Clinical Study Team (CST), and others, as applicable.
* Shares regulatory information and implications with the GRT and other Global teams on an ongoing basis and provides advice on international considerations. Participates in LWG/ELB meetings with advice on local deviation requests.
* Partners with the peers to agree on product strategy including projected submission and approval time.
* Maintains regular communications with the local teams to ensure alignment on strategy and keep the countries informed of status on the product development.
* Partners with peers to ensure consistency in procedures.
* Builds effective relationships and communication paths across the Global and Local elements of the GRAAS function


**REGULATORY RESEARCH**
* Maintains an awareness of new and developing legislation, regulatory policy and technical Regulatory guidance relating to Amgen products.
* Performs regulatory research to obtain relevant histories, precedence and other information relevant to regional product advancement.


**Knowledge And Skills\- Scientific And Technical**
* Knowledge of Regulatory principles.
* Working with policies, procedures and SOP’s.
* Comprehensive understanding of regulatory activities and how they impact other projects and/or processes.
* General knowledge of national legislation and regulations relating to medicinal products.
* General awareness of the registration procedures/challenges in the region for CTAs, MAs and all lifecycle management activities.
* Knowledge and experience in the international regulatory environment relevant for product area and development stage.
* Understanding of drug development.


**Others**
* Demonstrate strong team work ability.
* Good communication skills \- both oral and written.
* Good negotiation and Influencing skills.
* Ability to understand and communicate scientific/clinical information.
* Ability to resolve conflicts and develop a course of action leading to a beneficial outcome.
* Cultural awareness and sensitivity to achieve results across both regional, country and International borders.


**Education \& Experience (Basic)**
* Doctorate degree and 6 years of directly related experience
* OR
* Master’s degree and 8 years of directly related experience
* OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of directly related experience


**Education \& Experience (Preferred)**
* 8\-13 years of experience with degree and in\-depth regulatory experience and/or related to the region.
* In\-depth knowledge of regional countries legislation and regulations relating to medicinal products.
